What is UPCATET?

The UPCATET is a state-level entrance exam which is conducted once a year. The UPCATET exam is conducted to evaluate applicants' performance who wish to get admission into various undergraduate and postgraduate programs in the agricultural fields.

This entrance exam is conducted for candidates who possess a domicile of Uttar Pradesh State. These courses are offered at Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture & Technology , Kanpur; Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University of Agriculture and Technology , Meerut; Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology, Kumarganj, Banda University of Agriculture and Technology, Banda, etc.  The UPCATET exam is conducted for a three-hour duration, and the test mode is offline (pen & paper) only.

UPCATET asks only multiple‑choice questions (MCQs). Every question has four options. Students must choose the right answer. These questions help to analyse the speed and basic knowledge. This type of question is used for undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD courses. The difficulty changes, but the format remains the same. MCQs help students finish the exam on time and cover many topics in one test.

UPCATET 2026 Cutoff

The minimum marks needed to qualify for the UPCATET exam are what we call the UPCATET Cutoff . The cutoff is released by the exam officials when the result is out. Those who clear the UPCATET Cutoff will be called for the UPCATET Counselling process .

The minimum cut-off is 20 per cent (for the General category) and 10 per cent (for the SC or ST category) students to qualify for the exam. Those who fail to pass the cutoff will not be called for the UPCATET Admission process . The cutoff of every year can vary based on the total students who take the exam and the toughness of the exam. Students who are preparing for the UPCATET exam should go through the past year's cutoff to get an idea about the current year's cutoff.

What is UPCATET?

The UPCATET is a state-level entrance exam which is conducted once a year. The UPCATET exam is conducted to evaluate applicants' performance who wish to get admission into various undergraduate and postgraduate programs in the agricultural fields.

This entrance exam is conducted for candidates who possess a domicile of Uttar Pradesh State. These courses are offered at Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture & Technology , Kanpur; Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University of Agriculture and Technology , Meerut; Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology, Kumarganj, Banda University of Agriculture and Technology, Banda, etc.  The UPCATET exam is conducted for a three-hour duration, and the test mode is offline (pen & paper) only.

Students may be prohibited by the exam conducting authorities in case of any issue mentioned in the admit card from the identity of applicants

faqs.question: Can I show the admit card for UPCATET on the mobile phone in exam hall?
faqs.answer: No, it is mandatory for candidates to carry a hard copy of the UPCATET admit card on exam day as required by the invigilator for exam attendance formalities. Since applicants will not be allowed to appear by carrying mobile phone in the exam hall hence applicants must carry the admit card of UPCATET to the authorities. Students just need to carry their original id & photo id proof to the UPCATET exam centre.

faqs.question: What to do if I forget the password of the UPCATET admit card login?
faqs.answer: Applicants who forget the password of their admit card of UPCATET while downloading it.  Candidates can recover the password of their UPCATET exam by clicking on the ' Forgot Password ' button at the bottom of the login window. The exam conducting authorities will send the password of UPCATET to the registered email of the candidates. In case of not recieving any email applicants need to immediately contact to exam conducting authorities.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for UG courses for UPCATET exam?
faqs.answer: The Undergraduate syllabus is similar to Class 12 Science. It includes Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Maths, and General Studies. Students who want to study Agriculture also learn Agril. Botany, Agril. Chemistry, Horticulture, Agronomy, and Animal Husbandry. These subjects help students understand basic agriculture ideas. The syllabus is not difficult for students who have a Science background in school.

faqs.question: Name some important topics of UPCATET PG syllabus.
faqs.answer: The PG syllabus is based on UG subjects. It includes Agriculture, Horticulture, Soil Science, Biotechnology, Extension Education, and similar fields. These types of topics need in-depth knowledge. Students must revise what they studied while preparing for the UPCATET Exam during their graduation. This syllabus helps students prepare for PG courses in agriculture.

faqs.question: How to access the UPCATET Syllabus?
faqs.answer: Students can download the full syllabus for UG, PG, and PhD from the official portal. The syllabus is shared by NDUAT and Banda University. It lists all subjects and topics in detail. Students should download the official PDF so they follow the correct syllabus while studying.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the UPCATET Syllabus for UG, PG and PhD?
faqs.answer: Yes, the syllabus is different at the individual level. The UG syllabus is based on Class 12 Science subjects. The PG syllabus is based on what students learn in their Bachelor's degree. The PhD syllabus is deeper and more detailed. It includes in-depth information in one specific area.

faqs.question: What is the UPCATET Exam pattern?
faqs.answer: The UPCATET 2026 exam is not complex. The UPCATET paper has 200 questions in total. All questions are MCQ type. The total marks are 800. The mode of the exam is offline, so students write on paper. The exam duration is 3 hours. The language of the UPCATET exam paper is Hindi and English. Students can choose the language they know. This pattern helps students understand the exam easily.

faqs.question: What are the type of questions come in the UPCATET exam?
faqs.answer: UPCATET asks only multiple‑choice questions (MCQs). Every question has four options. Students must choose the right answer. These questions help to analyse the speed and basic knowledge. This type of question is used for undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD courses. The difficulty changes, but the format remains the same. MCQs help students finish the exam on time and cover many topics in one test.

faqs.question: What is the scoring scheme of the UPCATET Exam?
faqs.answer: For every right answer, students get 4 marks, and for a wrong answer,  1 mark is subtracted. If a student does not answer a question, no mark is removed. Students must think while answering a question. A better understanding of the UPCATET scoring system helps students who study well and answer carefully.

faqs.question: What is the mode and timing of UPCATET entrance exam?
faqs.answer: The UPCATET exam is 3 hours long. This provides sufficient time to answer 200 questions. The exam is held in offline mode at exam centres. Students must use a pen and paper. The UPCATET paper comes in Hindi and English. This helps students choose the language they are more comfortable with.

faqs.question: What login credentials are required to check UPCATET result?
faqs.answer: Applicants who will appear in UPCATET exam first visit the official website of the portal or visit Shiksha page. Then they have to click on link mentioned as " UPCATET Results ". After clicking on the result a new window will be opened in which students have to fill login details such as their registration number (which was provided during registration time) and password (which will be sent to applicants on their registered email & mobile). After entering these details candidates will be able to access their result of UPCATET exam. Download and save it for future reference.

faqs.question: Can I show the admit card for UPCATET on the mobile phone in exam hall?
faqs.answer: No, it is mandatory for candidates to carry a hard copy of the UPCATET admit card on exam day as required by the invigilator for exam attendance formalities. Since applicants will not be allowed to appear by carrying mobile phone in the exam hall hence applicants must carry the admit card of UPCATET to the authorities. Students just need to carry their original id & photo id proof to the UPCATET exam centre.

faqs.question: How many marks do I need to score to be able to crack the UPCATET Exam?
faqs.answer: As per previous years' statistics, the application numbers are increasing each year, and therefore, students need to buckle up to prepare for the competitive exams. To get an idea based on the previous year's statistics, students must know that if they want to score well, it should be more than 400 marks, then 370 marks is also good, the average score is 300, and the below-average score is less than 300. However, these scores are based on the difficulty level of this exam, and this has nothing to do with students' capability as individuals.

faqs.question: What to do the after declaration of results of UPCATET?
faqs.answer: Applicants who qualify the UPCATET exam for the respective courses for which they have applied further need to appear in counselling. Applicants need to join counselling process possess the following items i.e Mobile phone, email id, date of birth, roll number and scanned copy of documents. The process of counselling includes registration, choice filling, seat allotment, uploading of document, document verification, dowloading of allotment letter and last admission process of the allotted universities .

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for UPCATET exam?
faqs.answer: Those who wish to give the UPCATET exam must score a minimum of 20 per cent if they come from the General category, and for SC/ST, the cutoff is 10 per cent.

faqs.question: How to prepare for UPCATET exam to qualify in first attempt?
faqs.answer: Applicants who want to prepare and qualify UPCATET exam in first attempt must have a concrete plan and then execution becomes important to qualify it. The UPCATET exam is held once in year hence candidates preparing for the exam must complete their syllabus in advance at least 3 months before the commencement of exam. Now devotee last 3 months to practise the previous year question papers. Candidates need to ensure that they are completing the practise paper less than the given time in examination, which will eventually boost their confidence to attempt the paper within time in the examination hall.

faqs.question: How to check UPCATET Cutoff?
faqs.answer: After the UPCATET exam is over, the exam officials release the cutoff on the official portal. Students who clear the cutoff become eligible to participate in the counselling process. Students need to visit the official portal to check out their UPCATET Cutoff.

faqs.question: Will open and distance education be considered for educational qualification of UPCATET eligibility?
faqs.answer: The exam conducting authority has clearly mentioned in the official broucher that " Open & Distance Education " will be considered for educational qualification eligibility criteria of UPCATET. Applicants who have completed their education as full time course will be eligible to fill the form and apply online. Only those students are required to fill the application form who fulfill the eligibility criteria prescribed by the authorities.

faqs.question: What are the details which will be printed on the UPCATET score card?
faqs.answer: The exam conducting authorities will release the result as well as the score card of applicants in online mode only. Candidates who have appeared in the exam can check the below-mentioned details in their score card: Candidate's Name Candidate's Roll No. Qualifying Status Individual and total passing marks Rank of candidate Applicants who have secured the minimum passing marks will be declared qualified in the UPCATET exam and must participate in further process.

faqs.question: What will be the validity of UPCATET Results?
faqs.answer: The validity of the UPCATET result is only considered for those candidates who qualify for the exam. The validity of UPCATET results will be valid for one year. Applicants need to use their score card to appear in the counseling for their respective courses in the same year only. After the completion of one year, students will be able to appear with a different scorecard.

faqs.question: Will the hard copy of the UPCATET scorecard be sent to the candidates?
faqs.answer: Applicants who have appeared in the UPCATET exam and whether they have qualified for the exam should note that the exam conducting authorities don't send any hard copy of the result or score card to the candidates by post. Since the result & score card of UPCATET will be released in the online mode and it will be in PDF format only. Candidates need to note that no document is shared via post, whether it is an application form acknowledgment, admit card, or result.

faqs.question: Is there different exam pattern for UG and PG programme?
faqs.answer: Yes there will be different exam pattern of UG and PG courses in UPCATET exam. The UG courses i.e BSc & BTech and Post graduate courses i.e MBA, MSc have different pattern. The number of courses for UG is 200 while for PG it is 100 . The total marks allotted for UG courses is 600, while for PG it is 300. Though each question from UG and PG weigh same 3 marks only . Time duration for both UG and PG is also different, UG is of 3 hours and PG is of 2 hours .

faqs.question: What are steps for UPCATET counselling?
faqs.answer: Follow the below mentioned steps for counselling process. Online UPCATET counselling registration (fees submission) and documents upload. Online choice filling and Locking. Seat allocation and Security fee deposit. Report at respective universities. By following these steps the admission process of a candidate will be completed after declaratio of UPCATET results.

faqs.question: Can a student from Bihar appear for UPCATET exam.
faqs.answer: No a student who belong to Bihar can not appear in UPCATET exam. As according to UPCATET eligibility criteria: A) Such students who are living in UP from the last 5 years and have completed the required qualification from state only. B) Such citizens of India whose father’s residence or place of origin is UP and he/she also belong to UP. C) Such citizens of India whose father’s residence or their residence is not from UP but they acquired and have been living in the state for 5 years.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of UPCATET?
faqs.answer: The UPCATET exam is compratively easy in comparison to JEE Main, BITSAT etc. exam. Applicants who have secured atleast 60 % marks in their academic exam are more likely to qualify the exam. Since it is state owned examination and number of users are also less in comparison to other competitve exam. Applicants just need to complete the syllabus within time and practise more and more to qualify the exam with good marks.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in UPCATET exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a negative marking scheme in the UPCATET exam. For each correct answer applicants will be given 4 marks . For each incorrect answer, 1/4th of the total marks or 1 mark will be deducted. The calculation of the score for the respective programmes will be taken into consideration by taking into account all correct & incorrect answers. After preparing the list of all candidates the authorities will prepare the list of successful applicants based on the availability of seats .

faqs.question: Which course can I get after qualifying for the UPCATET exam?
faqs.answer: There are various courses which can be offered after qualifying UPCATET exam. UG Courses BSc (Hons) Agriculture BSc (Hons) Horticulture BSc (Hons) Forestry BSc (Hons) Home Science BVSc&AH BFSc BTech Biotechnology BTech Agriculture Engineering BTech Dairy Technology BTech Computer Science BTech Mechanical Engineering BTech Electronics & Communication Engineering PG Courses MSc Agriculture MSc Home Science MSc Veterinary Science MSc Horticulture MVSc MTech Agricultural Engineering MTech Mechanical Engineering MTech/ MSc Biotechnology MBA Agribusiness Applicants who will qualify the exam will be able to take admission in the above mentioned courses.

faqs.question: Is there any eligibility criteria to apply UPCATET exam?
faqs.answer: There are different eligibility criteria decided by the exam conducting authorities whcih includes both age as well as education for UG courses . There is no age limit for PG and PhD courses . For BVSC & H course the minimum and maximum age limit of candidate need to be 17 and 25 by December 31 . While for all other course the minimum and maximum age limit of candidates need to be 16 and 22 by December 31 . Note: Person with Disability (PwD) will be given a relexation of 5 years in upper age limit.

faqs.question: What is the application fees to fill the UPCATET Exam form?
faqs.answer: The UPCATET application fee is required to be paid after filling out the form. otherwise the form will not be accepted by the authorities. Every year, the updated fee structure is given in the UPCATET 2026 notification. But according to the previous year's information, male students who belong to the General & OBC categories have to pay INR 1350 . Other students, both male and female, have to pay INR 1100 application fees. The application fees need to be paid online via Debit card, Credit card, Net banking, etc. Once the fee is paid, students are required to download the receipt of fees.

faqs.question: What to do the after declaration of results of UPCATET?
faqs.answer: Applicants who qualify the UPCATET exam for the respective courses for which they have applied further need to appear in counselling. Applicants need to join counselling process possess the following items i.e Mobile phone, email id, date of birth, roll number and scanned copy of documents. The process of counselling includes registration, choice filling, seat allotment, uploading of document, document verification, dowloading of allotment letter and last admission process of the allotted universities .

faqs.question: What are the UPCATET participating universities?
faqs.answer: There are four participating universities offering admissions on the basis of UPCATET results which are as follows: Banda University of Agriculture & Technology Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology Chandra Shekhar Azad University Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University of Agriculture and Technology. Applicants who want to participate and take admission in these universities must appear UPCATET exam and pass the exam with good marks.

faqs.question: What are the important things to know before applying for UPCATET 2026?
faqs.answer: Before applying, candidates must ensure the following points: Candidates must meet the eligibility criteria to be eligible to appear for the UPCATET Exam for their preferred courses. Keep all the important documents ready for the admission process. Submit the application fee before the end date.

faqs.question: What is the UPCATET syllabus?
faqs.answer: UPCATET syllabus consists of Class 11 and 12 topics of Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Agriculture, and Home Science. The UPCATET Syllabus is also based on the paper group selected by the students, like PCB/PCM/PAG/PHS. The NCERT is suggested for all Science subjects.

faqs.question: What are the factors that decide UPCATET cut‑off?
faqs.answer: The UPCATET Cutoff marks are based on the following factors: The overall difficulty of the exam. Number of students appear for the UPCATET Exam. Total number of seats for UG and PG courses. Since the paper is marked out of 800 marks, cut‑offs typically reflect relative performance. After the result, UPCATET cut‑off is released for all categories. Students need to fulfil the minimum scoring criteria to get admission to their preferred courses.

faqs.question: What are the ways to prepare for UPCATET exam?
faqs.answer: Check out the following points to know relevant strategies while preparing for the UPCATET entrance exam . Include main subjects and topics from the NCERT books. Use objective‑type MCQ books to practise daily. Select the preferred groups out of PCB, PCM, PAG, PHS and solve last year's UPCATET question papers. Practice OMR sheets because the UPCATET exam is held offline. Practise mock tests within 3 hours. Also, include important chapters to improve the UPCATET score.

faqs.question: What is structure of UPCATET Question paper?
faqs.answer: UPCATET consist of a total of four groups: PCB, PCM, PAG, and PHS. Every group includes 200 MCQs. The exam is 3 hours. The total UPCAET exam is assessed for 800 marks. The courses are assigned based on the group that students choose.

What is MGU CAT?

Mahatma Gandhi University Common Admission Test or MGU CAT is conducted by Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam for admissions to MSc, MA, Master of Tourism and Travel Management, LLM and M.Ed. and other courses. For admission to the MBA programmes offered by MGU , candidates are selected on the basis of CMAT / CAT / KMAT score. For admission to MTech programme, candidates with GATE score can apply directly. MA Politics & International Relations/Politics & Human Rights/Public Policy & Governance, MA Economics, MA Malayalam, MA in English, MA Gandhian Studies/Development Studies and MA History and Anthropology syllabus include subjects studied in undergraduate course. MEd syllabus for English/Hindi/Malayalam/Sanskrit/Arabic/Mathematics/Science/Social Science/Commerce/Computer Education include subjects studied in undergraduate course. faqs.question: Can Diploma holders apply for KIITEE 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, in that case, aspirants must have passed three years Diploma course in engineering with at least 60% marks in aggregate from State Council of Technical Education of any state or its equivalent. Candidates can check the course-wise eligibility criteria for BTech (LE) below - For admission into following branches Eligible Diploma holders Civil engineering Civil engineering Mechanical Engineering/Automobile Engineering/Mechatronics/Aerospace Engineering Mechanical Engineering/ Automobile Engineering/Production Engineering/Mechtronics/Aerospace Electrical Engineering Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Electrical Engineering Electronics and Electrical Engineering/ Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering/Electronics and Computer Science Engineering/Electronics - VLSI Design and Technology Eectrical Engineering/Electronics and Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering/Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering/Electronics Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering/ Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Chemical Engineering Chemical Engineering

faqs.question: What is the minimum qualifying mark for KIITEE?
faqs.answer: The qualifying marks for the KIITEE are different for each stream or discipline. Candidates securing the minimum qualifying mark will be eligible for further admission. For BTech programmes of four years duration, the applicant must have passed 10+2 in 2024 or 2025 or must be appearing in the final year examination. The minimum qualifying mark for BTech admission is 60% in Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry. BTech and MTech Biotechnology's minimum qualifying mark is 60% in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology. For MTech courses, B.E or BTech or any equivalent specialisation in a relevant engineering and technology discipline with a first-class or equivalent CGPA or first-class MCA/first-class MSc are required.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for KIITEE?
faqs.answer: Applicants applying for KIITEE 2026 do not have to pay the KIITEE application fee to complete registration. The application process of the KIITEE entrance exam includes registration, filling form and uploading the required documents. Applicants are advised to keep a copy of the filled application form after completing the KIITEE registration process.

faqs.question: What documents are required to upload in the KIITEE 2026 application form?
faqs.answer: Candidates must upload the following documents (as per the specifications) while filling out the KIITEE application form- A recent passport-sized photograph of not more than 50 Kb must be scanned and uploaded in JPG format. A scanned copy of the signature is in JPG format. The size of the signature must not be more than 50 Kb. Class 10th and 12th certificates and mark sheets must be uploaded in JPG format and must not exceed 1 MB.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to send a hard copy of the KIITEE application form to the university?
faqs.answer: No, candidates are not required to send a hard copy of the filled KIITEE application form to the University. Applicants need to fill the KIITEE application form 2026 in online mode at kiitee.kiit.ac.in.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of the KIITEE BTech?
faqs.answer: The KIITEE BTech entrance exam is considered mainly moderate level, and can be easy if the fundamentals are right. The KIITE BTech question paper is curated with questions focusing on the core concepts of Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. If compared to JEE Main and WBJEE, the difficulty level is on the easier side. To understand more about the question pattern and format of the questions, candidates can refer to the KIITEE sample paper available on its official website.

faqs.question: How do I begin using KIITEE sample papers for preparation?
faqs.answer: To prepare using the KIITEE sample papers, start by understanding the KIITEE exam pattern and syllabus. Identify your weak areas and start solving as many questions as possible. Solve question papers daily to enhance time management skills and be familiar with the exam difficulty level.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus of KIITEE B.Tech (Lateral Entry) Mathematics?
faqs.answer: The mathematics syllabus for KIITEE-Engineering (BTech lateral entry) is as follows - Ordinary differential equations Series method Laplace transform Fourier series Matrix and Vectors

faqs.question: Do I need to cover the entire syllabus for KIITEE preparation?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates are advised to cover the complete syllabus for their preparations. Do not leave any top untouched. The exam paper of KIITEE comprises questions from all the topics. To prioritise the topics, candidates can pick high-weightage topics first. Leaving any topic will increase the Probability of losing marks.

faqs.question: How can KIITEE sample papers help me understand the exam pattern?
faqs.answer: KIITEE sample papers are often based on the trends of the previous years and expected question formats. They familarise you with the exam structure, types of questions, and difficulty level of the KIITEE question paper.

faqs.question: What is the distribution of marks among the various sections in KIITEE Engineering exam?
faqs.answer: The KIITEE Engineering (BTech) question paper comprises three sections, namely- Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Each section carries a total of 40 questions, i.e, Physics - 40 questions, Mathematics - 40 questions, and Chemistry - 40 questions. For each correct answer, 4 marks will be rewarded. A negative marking of one mark is deducted for an incorrect answer. The total marks allotted for the KIITEE BTech question paper is 480 marks.

faqs.question: How to prepare for the KIITEE exam?
faqs.answer: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology conducts KIITEE exam every year for admissions to various courses. Applicants looking for admissions are advised to first go through the KIITEE syllabus thoroughly. It helps candidates to prepare an effective strategy to ace the exam with a good score. Along with the syllabus, applicants must also go through KIITEE exam pattern to understand the scheme of the exam. Applicants are advised to study regularly with short breaks. Do not take much stress. It is important to understand the basic concept. Regular practice helps to boost confidence of students.

faqs.question: How many phases are conducted for KIITEE exam?
faqs.answer: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology conducts KIITEE exam in three phases. Applicants do not need to fill separate application form for all phases. However, students have to complete the KIITEE 2026 slot booking separately for each phase. The exam authority will issue the admit card separately for all phases of the KIITEE exam.

faqs.question: What is the KIITEE 2026 slot booking date?
faqs.answer: The KIITEE 2026 slot booking date will be announced online. It is typically available along with the hall ticket download.

faqs.question: Can I choose my KIITEE exam date?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates can choose their preferred KIITEE exam date through the slot booking facility.

faqs.question: What is the last date to download KIITEE admit card 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates will be able to download their KIITEE admit card at kiitee.kiit.ac.in. Candidates first need to complete the KIITEE slot booking before downloading the admit card. The exam authority will allow candidates to download the KIITEE admit card till the exam date.

faqs.question: What should I do? I am having problems downloading the KIITEE Admit Card.
faqs.answer: There is a toll-free and effective guide for resolving the problem of downloading the KIITEE Admit Card. Firstly, take into consideration whether you have entered your appropriate login credentials, including application number and password provided during the registration process. Be sure to check your compatibility regarding internet connection, browser usage, or emptying the browser cache and cookies since these can also be causing access problems. On the other hand, go to the official website of KIITEE and check if there are any the latest notifications published related to the release of the admit card. In addition to the above, you might want to check your email for any instruction or link sent by the exam authorities related to it. If none helps, you have to contact the concerned KIITEE helpline or admission office directly.

faqs.question: What are the credentials required for Kalinga University admit card download?
faqs.answer: Candidates appearing in the exam can download the KIITEE admit card through their application number and date of birth. Applicants first have to complete the KIITEE slot booking process. At the time of KIIT slot booking, applicants have to fill preferred exam date, centre and exam slot. After successful slot booking, candidates can download the KIITEE admit card.

faqs.question: Is it better to solve KIITEE sample papers topic-wise or as complete papers?
faqs.answer: If you are just starting, solve topic-wise specific sections to strengthen particular areas. As the exam approachers, practice full-length KIITEE sample papers to develop an integrated understanding and exam strategy.

faqs.question: What is the pattern of KIITEE-Engineering exam?
faqs.answer: The Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) has issued the exam pattern for BTech in the information brochure. The KIITEE-Engineering 2026 pattern is as follows - The mode of the exam is online with a test duration of 150 minutes. A total of 40 questions will be asked in the computer-based test. Questions will be asked from Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. The KIITEE question paper will be in English. Each correct answer carries four marks and there is negative marking of one mark for an incorrect option.

faqs.question: What is the next step after declaration of KIITEE branch allotment result?
faqs.answer: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology will release the KIITEE branch allotment result date on the official website. The next step after the branch allotment result is the payment of the admission confirmation fee. Candidates need to pay the required fee in online mode to confirm their admission. After successful payment of the fee, candidates need to report to the respective institute for document verification and further admission process. Applicants are advised to have all the documents ready before appearing in the counselling.

faqs.question: When KIITEE Law Entrance Exam Result 2026 will be announced?
faqs.answer: In accordance with the standard KIITEE 2026 result timing, which is typically during the fourth week of April 2026, the KIITEE Law Entrance Exam 2026 result is anticipated to be announced.  Although unique access links for law may be available via the KIIT School of Law website, results will be posted online at kiitee.kiit.ac.in, the official KIITEE portal. Following the outcome, what comes next? Enter your application number and birthdate to download your scorecard. Get ready for seat allocation and counselling, which normally take place in May 2026 for all streams, including law. Advice: For information about counselling and the link to the results, see the official website starting in mid-April 2026.

faqs.question: What is the KIITEE result date?
faqs.answer: The authority will announce the KIITEE 2026 result date online at kiitee.kiit.ac.in.

faqs.question: How are the KIITEE ranks assigned?
faqs.answer: KIITEE ranks are assigned based on the total score in the exam, with a separate merit list generated for each course (like B.Tech, Law, etc.) by ranking candidates from the highest to the lowest score.

faqs.question: How can I check KIITEE branch allotment result?
faqs.answer: The authority will release the KIITEE 2026 branch allotment result on the official website. The details required to check the KIITEE branch allotment are the application number and date of birth. To check the KIIT branch allotment, candidates have to. Visit the KIITEE official website. Click on the BTech counselling link. Now, click on the branch allotment result link. Enter the required login credentials. The branch allotment result of KIITEE will be shown on the screen.

faqs.question: What is KIITEE counselling choice filling process?
faqs.answer: The exam authority will commence the KIITEE choice filling process in online mode at the official website. At the time of KIITEE choice filling, candidates need to fill their preferred choices of courses as per their preference. The branch allotment of KIITEE is released on the basis of preferences filled by candidates at the time of the KIITEE choice filling process.

faqs.question: When will authorities commence the KIITEE choice filling facility?
faqs.answer: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology will commence the KIITEE choice filling online at the official website. Applicants can complete the KIITEE choice filling separately for all the phases. Candidates have to fill their preferred choices of courses at the time of choice filling of KIITEE. The exam authority allots the course and branches to candidates as per the seat availability. Applicants have to save their preferences after filling in all the choices.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

Students can choose up to four subjects in the CUET PG 2026 exam. The choice of subjects would depend on the course studied in graduation and the universities opted for.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG exam pattern?
faqs.answer: NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

faqs.question: Can I prepare for CUET PG 2026 exam in 2 months?

faqs.question: What are some preparation Tips for Mediocre Students in CUET PG?
faqs.answer: Firstly, understand your strengths and weaknesses, then focus on the fundamentals, create a personalized study plan, set realistic goals, effective study techniques.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in Section B of the CUET PG exam?

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

faqs.answer: In case of any discrepancy in the particulars of the candidate or his/her photograph and signature shown on the CUET-PG admit card, candidates should immediately approach the NTA Help Line between 10.00 A. M. and 5.00 P. M. NTA mentions, "In such a case, the candidate would appear in the examination with the already downloaded Admit Card. However, NTA will take necessary action to make corrections in the record later. Hence, candidates need not worry about the possibility of not getting allowed inside the CUET PG 2026 exam centre. However, they must follow up with NTA before the commencement of the admission process.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG Advance City Intimation Slip?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG intimation slip is the precursor to the admit card. In this document candidates will only be intimated about city where their CUET PG exam centre has been allotted. The objective of this document is to help candidates prepare in advance regarding the exam day travel or commute.

faqs.question: If I do not receive my CUET-PG admit card, what should I do?
faqs.answer: Candidates are advised to immediately contact the officials and the conducting body if the candidate is not able to download their CUET-PG admit cards. The contact details will be provided on exam website and the information bulletin as well. At the same time, they must ensure that they had completed the application process carefully by paying the application fee. Unless they have completed the application process successfully, they will not be issued the admit card of CUET-PG.

faqs.question: How can I get CUET PG 2026 Syllabus PDF?
faqs.answer: Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

faqs.question: How many candidates appear for CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

faqs.question: Has NTA announced dates for CUET PG 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. NTA has announced CUET PG 2026 exam dates for various streams. Exam will begin on march 6,  2026. Last exam will be held on March 27,  2026. Exam will be ehld for a duration of 20 days. Exam will be held in computer-based mode for 157 subjects.

faqs.question: How many subjects can candidates choose for the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Students can choose up to four subjects in the CUET PG 2026 exam. The choice of subjects would depend on the course studied in graduation and the universities opted for.

faqs.question: What is a good score in CUET PG?
faqs.answer: Though good score varies for each stream and colleges, score of 270 out of 300 is considered good enough to get top colleges in CUET PG exam. Students who score 200 to 250 also get colleges of their choice. Students should aim to score at least 200 to get admission in CUET PG exam.

faqs.question: What is the passing marks for CUET PG?
faqs.answer: NTA doesn't release cutoff marks for each speciality for CUET PG exam. Cutoff depends upon difficulty level, number of students etc. Students do need to try to score maximum marks out of 300 to increase their chances of admission.

faqs.question: Does Faculty of Law, BHU accept CUET-PG score for LLM admission?
faqs.answer: Actually yes, faculty of Law BHU accept applicants CUET-PG scores for selection. Candidates seeking admission must a valid score in the national-level examination.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: Is CUET PG held twice a year?
faqs.answer: No, CUET PG is conducted once a year. CUET PG 2026 is expected to be held in March 2026. The exam is conducted as a computer-based test (online mode). CUET PG exam duration is 90 minutes.

faqs.question: Is there a common counselling process for CUET PG?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG counselling process is conducted separately by the participating universities. Qualifying students have to register and participate in the counselling process. There will not be a common counselling process.

faqs.question: Can I apply for CUET PG exam in offline mode?
faqs.answer: No, there is no option to apply for the CUET PG in offline mode. Students have to go to the exam website to apply for the exam. The fee has to be also paid in online mode, through Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI.

faqs.question: Government university/college in Delhi that we can get with 90 marks in CUET PG EWS category.
faqs.answer: Score of 90 marks in CUET PG, considering you are under the EWS category, your admission will be based on several factors. Given below are some of the Government Universities/Colleges in Delhi you may opt for: 1. University of Delhi Under its constituent colleges, the University of Delhi offers a large number of postgraduate programs. CUET PG admissions in various courses are offered in different colleges and departments at DU, each differing regarding cut-offs for a particular course or department. 2. Jawaharlal Nehru University JNU offers a wide range of postgraduate courses through its schools. It also offers many of the programs that CUET PG was used as an entry criterion for. Cut-offs for EWS candidates may be marginally lower than those of the general category.

faqs.question: What was date of release of CUET PG Application Form 2026?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 application form was released on December 14, 2025 online. Last date to submit application form for CUET PG 2026 was January 23, 2026. It must be noted NTA only accept online applications for CUET PG exam.

faqs.question: Can CUET PG Applications filled offline?
faqs.answer: No. CUET PG applications are accepted in online mode only. NTA, the exam conducting body doesn't accept any offline application form for CUET exam. If someone sends application by any offline modes such as Fax or by hand, that will not be accepted.

faqs.question: How many city preferences one can fill out in CUET PG Application form?
faqs.answer: For the CUET PG 2026 exam, candidates could fill out a maximum of four city preferences. Although initially, NTA announced the selection of two exam cities, as per a later notification, candidates could choose four exam cities in their present or permanent address.

faqs.question: What is the CUET PG application fee for NRI students?
faqs.answer: Candidates can check out the CUET PG application form fees 2026 for outside India candidates from here: CUET PG 2026 fee Outside India Number of Subjects General Fee in INR Up to three subjects INR 7,000 For each additional subject INR 3,500 each

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG exam pattern?
faqs.answer: NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

faqs.question: Can I prepare for CUET PG 2026 exam in 2 months?
faqs.answer: Well it all depends on the individual. Some students takes time to prepare for CUET PG exam, about 6 months. But yes, you can do the preparation within 2 months also by executing a proper plan and making best of your ability.

faqs.question: What are the tips for candidates preparing for the CUET PG exam in CBT mode?
faqs.answer: Follow these tips: Get familiar with the format Practice taking CBT mock tests Understanding of computer skills Practice taking CBT mock tests.

faqs.question: What are some strategies to manage time effectively during the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Understand exam structure, practice within time limit, prioritise and strategise challenging questions, read very carefully.

faqs.question: What are some preparation Tips for Mediocre Students in CUET PG?
faqs.answer: Firstly, understand your strengths and weaknesses, then focus on the fundamentals, create a personalized study plan, set realistic goals, effective study techniques.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in Section B of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG 2026 exam pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions in total. Hence, the Section B will not be there.

faqs.question: What are the Masters courses offered through CUET PG?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 is a national-level entrance exam for candidates who wish to pursue their Masters degree from the central universities. From the past years, many other state, private, and deemed universities is participating in the CUET PG examination. The examination will offer admission to a range of master's courses including normal and professional degree courses: PG Courses Professional Degree Courses MA MSc MCA MCom MFA MBA LLB LLM BEd MEd

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in section A of CUET PG examination?
faqs.answer: As per the previous exam pattern of the CUET PG exam, there were 25 questions in Section A. As per the latest or the revised CUET PG pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions. The Section A or the General section has been removed since CUET PG 2025.

faqs.answer: Only those candidates who took the CUET PG exam will be able to download the provisional answer keys. However, the final answer keys of CUET PG accessible for all. The steps to download and check the CUET PG answer keys are given below: Visit the CUET PG website Click on the text or link indicating Answer Key Log in with application number and date of birth Enter the Security Pin given on screen and click on Submit Check and download the provisional answer keys of CUET PG

faqs.question: Can Test takers raise objection against CUET PG answer key?
faqs.answer: Yes, test takers of CUET PG examination will get the oppurtunity to raise objection against the CUET PG provisional answer key. NTA will release the CUET PG 2026 provisional answer key on the official webiste of CUET PG 2026 within two weeks of the exam conclusion. The provisional answer key is released for all the subjects for which the CUET PG examination is conducted. Test-takers can visit the official website of CUET PG and login to their accounts using the username and password to see the Provisional answer key and CUET PG 2026 candidate's response sheet.

faqs.question: When will NTA release CUET PG 2026 final answer key?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 final answer key will be released in the first week of May 2026. CUET PG 2026 Results will be compiled based on the corrections made in the provisional answer key (also called CUET PG Final answer key). Candidates can check and download the CUET PG 2026 final answer key by logging in using their enrolment ID or email ID along with the password on the official website.

faqs.question: How to Calculate Scores Based on CUET PG Answer Keys?
faqs.answer: Candidates will have to calculate their estimated scores based on the following method. Specifics Marks Awarded Each question carry Four marks Total number of questions- 75 300- Total/ Maximum Marks For correct response 4 marks awarded For incorrect response 1 mark will be deducted Unanswered/un-attempted answers 0 marks awarded

faqs.question: What is CUET PG passing marks?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Passing Marks are the scores or marks to be obtained to qualify for admission to the universities. If the candidate wants to know whether they have passed the CUET PG exam or not, they are required to check the cutoff marks released by the participating universities and colleges. After the declaration of the CUET PG result, all participating universities will release the course-wise passing marks or CUET PG cutoff, which will be used for shortlisting candidates for the counselling process.

faqs.question: What after CUET PG Result?
faqs.answer: Once result is downloaded candidates must preserve their CUET PG scorecard till admission process is concluded. CUET PG result includes several important details like candidate name, programme name, category, gender, qualification and eligibility.

faqs.question: What are the dates for CUET PG Results?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Result will be tentatively released in May 2026. Going by last year's trends, the exam will be conducted in a window of 15-20 days in March 2026. Followed by the release of the answer keys, the result will be declared in the first week of May 2026, on the exam website.

faqs.question: How to download CUET PG Result?
faqs.answer: Students need to follow the process given below to check the CUET PG result. Go to the website of CUET PG Click on the link indicating the CUET PG scorecard Log in with your CUET PG Application Number, password and date of Birth Enter the Security Pin and click on Submit Now you can download the CUET PG scorecard The CUET PG scorecard has to be preserved till the admission or counselling process is over. The validity of the CUET PG result is one year.

faqs.question: How many subjects can be opted in CUET PG while filling the application form?

However, from the previous year academic year, they were able to choose a maximum of 20 test paper codes in all. Before choosing multiple subjects for the examination, candidates are advised to check the minimum education eligibility criteria for the particular course they have applied for. Also, check the university-specific subject criteria for the subject a candidate wants to appear for.

preparation.title: DAVV CET Preparation 2022: Tips, Strategy & Guide

author.name: Shruti Garg
author.role: By Shruti Garg , Assistant Manager- Editorial

blocks.value: DAVV CET is conducted for admission to various undergraduate and postgraduate courses offered by the university and its affiliated colleges. Notification for the exam is usually released in May and the exam is held in June. Candidates have one year to prepare for the exam. Six months’ time is considered ideal for DAVV CET exam preparation. To qualify for the exam, candidates need to do smart and targeted preparation. Here we have discussed the preparation strategy for candidates who will begin their DAVV CET exam now.
How to prepare for DAVV CET 2022?
Brushing up the basic concepts
Candidates should dedicate two to three months to learning the basic concepts brushing up on the fundamentals of the different topics.
Attempt mock test & previous year papers

Candidates should attempt mock tests and solve DAVV CET question papers . This will help them analyse where they stand in terms of knowledge. Candidates will also get to measure their progress as they go along with their preparation.
Prepare a study plan

Candidates should envisage a study plan and stick to it till it delivers desired results. It is not necessary to study 8 to 12 hours, studying 4 hours is also enough but candidates need to be focused and attentive towards their study. While preparation, pay equal attention to all the sections.
Categorise the topics

Candidates should categorize the topics to be covered as most difficult, difficult, moderate and easy. This will help them in a directed preparation. They should keep revising topics which are their strong point and focus on weak areas.
Learn shortcut tricks of solving questions
Candidates should learn the methods of solving questions in the quickest possible way. Learning shortcuts will help candidates solve questions more accurately and quickly.
Knowing syllabus and pattern
Candidates should know the DAVV CET exam pattern and syllabus well. A thorough understanding of the syllabus will help candidates pave way for efficient planning and preparation.
Study material
Candidates should make sure that they have all their study material and resources as per the DAVV CET syllabus in place for optimum preparation.

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.
As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.
CUET PG 2026 Preparation

The CUET PG preparation should start at least a year before the exam. Hence, students in their final year of college should start by knowing about the exam, followed by identifying the strengths and weaknesses, writing mock tests, to begin with.

value: Know the exam: First and foremost, know the exam pattern, in terms of duration, number and type of questions and marking scheme.
Select the papers or subjects: Next, select the subject or papers you want to opt for. According to NTA, students can select up to four test papers. Based on that, the preparation has to be done.

Check the syllabus: NTA provides a detailed syllabus for each subject. Before starting the preparation, students should go through the topics and chapters. The syllabus is designed in line with the curriculum of the Bachelor's degree courses or equivalent.

Get the right books and study materials: Generally, the college textbooks and study materials are sufficient for preparing for CUET PG 2026 . But students may look for subject-specific notes and guidebooks available in the market, published specifically for CUET PG preparation .

Solve previous years CUET PG question papers: The CUET PG question papers for the past years are released by NTA. Students are advised to download and solve them to gain an in-depth understanding of the question types and topics covered.

Take CUET PG mock tests: Taking CUET PG mock tests in an exam-specific environment and duration will act as the core for preparation. CUET PG mocks are provided by coaching institutes as well as NTA. Writing mock tests will not only help students in practising the questions, but also in other aspects, such as managing time and deciding the test-taking methods. After the mock tests, it is equally important to get the performance analysed by teachers to improve the performance.

faqs.question: What are some important instructions regarding CUET PG admit card?
faqs.answer: Candidates should keep in mind the following information in mind during and after downloading the CUET PG 2026 admit card. In case a candidate is unable to download his/ her CUET PG admit cards from the website, he or she may approach the Help Line 011 40759000 between 9.30 am to 5.30 pm or write an email to NTA. It is mandatory to get the admit card of CUET PG 2026 signed by a parent/guardian. It is mandatory to carry a valid photo ID proof on the day of CUET PG 2026. Candidates have to carry a passport-sized photograph on the day of the examination. This photograph has to be affixed to the attendance sheet. In case of any discrepancy in the particulars of the candidate or his/her photograph and signatures shown on the Admit Card and Confirmation Page, the candidate may immediately approach the Help Line between the timings given above. faqs.question: What to do if there is a discrepancy in CUET-PG admit card?

faqs.question: What is a good score in CUET PG?

faqs.question: What is the passing marks for CUET PG?

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG exam pattern?
faqs.answer: NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.
As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.
CUET PG 2026 Preparation

The CUET PG preparation should start at least a year before the exam. Hence, students in their final year of college should start by knowing about the exam, followed by identifying the strengths and weaknesses, writing mock tests, to begin with.

value: Know the exam: First and foremost, know the exam pattern, in terms of duration, number and type of questions and marking scheme.
Select the papers or subjects: Next, select the subject or papers you want to opt for. According to NTA, students can select up to four test papers. Based on that, the preparation has to be done.

Check the syllabus: NTA provides a detailed syllabus for each subject. Before starting the preparation, students should go through the topics and chapters. The syllabus is designed in line with the curriculum of the Bachelor's degree courses or equivalent.

Get the right books and study materials: Generally, the college textbooks and study materials are sufficient for preparing for CUET PG 2026 . But students may look for subject-specific notes and guidebooks available in the market, published specifically for CUET PG preparation .

Solve previous years CUET PG question papers: The CUET PG question papers for the past years are released by NTA. Students are advised to download and solve them to gain an in-depth understanding of the question types and topics covered.

Take CUET PG mock tests: Taking CUET PG mock tests in an exam-specific environment and duration will act as the core for preparation. CUET PG mocks are provided by coaching institutes as well as NTA. Writing mock tests will not only help students in practising the questions, but also in other aspects, such as managing time and deciding the test-taking methods. After the mock tests, it is equally important to get the performance analysed by teachers to improve the performance.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG exam pattern?

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

Students can choose up to four subjects in the CUET PG 2026 exam. The choice of subjects would depend on the course studied in graduation and the universities opted for.

CUET PG 2026 Exam: The CUET PG 2026 exam will be conducted over multiple days and slots for different subjects or papers. Candidates can appear for up to four papers. The subjects will be scheduled in such a manner that they do not clash. C UET PG exam dates 2026 were announced online. Exam is schedule from March 6, 2026.
