CUET PG Results 2026: The CUET PG results will be announced online a few weeks after the answer key release. The scorecard will mention the marks obtained in subjects along with their All India Rank.

CUET PG Counselling: The CUET PG counselling process will be conducted separately by the participating institutes. Candidates have to follow the instructions and formalities to get the seats allotted.

The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.
As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.
CUET PG 2026 Preparation

The CUET PG preparation should start at least a year before the exam. Hence, students in their final year of college should start by knowing about the exam, followed by identifying the strengths and weaknesses, writing mock tests, to begin with.

value: Know the exam: First and foremost, know the exam pattern, in terms of duration, number and type of questions and marking scheme.
Select the papers or subjects: Next, select the subject or papers you want to opt for. According to NTA, students can select up to four test papers. Based on that, the preparation has to be done.

Check the syllabus: NTA provides a detailed syllabus for each subject. Before starting the preparation, students should go through the topics and chapters. The syllabus is designed in line with the curriculum of the Bachelor's degree courses or equivalent.

Get the right books and study materials: Generally, the college textbooks and study materials are sufficient for preparing for CUET PG 2026 . But students may look for subject-specific notes and guidebooks available in the market, published specifically for CUET PG preparation .

Solve previous years CUET PG question papers: The CUET PG question papers for the past years are released by NTA. Students are advised to download and solve them to gain an in-depth understanding of the question types and topics covered.

Take CUET PG mock tests: Taking CUET PG mock tests in an exam-specific environment and duration will act as the core for preparation. CUET PG mocks are provided by coaching institutes as well as NTA. Writing mock tests will not only help students in practising the questions, but also in other aspects, such as managing time and deciding the test-taking methods. After the mock tests, it is equally important to get the performance analysed by teachers to improve the performance.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: How many universities accept CUET PG scores?
faqs.answer: Approximately 200 universities across India accept the CUET PG scores. The exam scores will be used to grant admission to the postgraduate or master's degree courses across multiple streams. After the result is declared, these universities will conduct their admission process separately. There is no common counselling process for the CUET PG participating universities. Candidates have to qualify for the CUET PG exam and meet the eligibility criteria for admission to the CUET PG participating universities.

faqs.question: What are the steps for CUET PG 2026 Counselling Process?
faqs.answer: After the CUET PG 2026 result declaration, the Participating Universities will separately release their merit list or shorlisted candidate's list who are selected for participating in the counselling process for that college. Candidates will then have to register and pay the requiste or asked registration fee for admission and visit the institution's campus with the list of documents. Some of the universities or institutes may conduct interviews for some specific courses.

faqs.question: In how many rounds will CUET PG 2026 counselling be concluded?
faqs.answer: The counselling process for CUET PG 2026 will be held separately for different participating universities under the CUET PG 2026 Examination. Therefore, the CUET PG 2026 Counselling Rounds are not specific to any number. Depending on the availability of vacant seats at that particular university of any course, the CUET PG counselling rounds will vary. But as per the previous year trend, candidates can expect at least two rounds of counselling for any course at one of the participating universities.

faqs.question: Who conducts CUET PG Counselling?
faqs.answer: Although NTA, National Testing Agency is the CUET PG 2026 examination conducting body but the CUET PG 2026 Counselling process is not conducted by NTA. As per the previous year trend, candidates can expect the counselling process for CUET PG 2026 will be held separately for different participating universities under the CUET PG 2026 Examination. It is expected that this year's counselling process will not be a combined counselling process.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

Students can choose up to four subjects in the CUET PG 2026 exam. The choice of subjects would depend on the course studied in graduation and the universities opted for.

CUET PG 2026 Exam: The CUET PG 2026 exam will be conducted over multiple days and slots for different subjects or papers. Candidates can appear for up to four papers. The subjects will be scheduled in such a manner that they do not clash. C UET PG exam dates 2026 were announced online. Exam is schedule from March 6, 2026.

CUET PG 2026 Answer Key: NTA will release the provisional CUET PG 2026 answer keys around a week after the exam. Students will be able to submit challenges within the given date. Based on the objections, the final answer key and result will be prepared.
CUET PG Results 2026: The CUET PG results will be announced online a few weeks after the answer key release. The scorecard will mention the marks obtained in subjects along with their All India Rank.

The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.
As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.answer: NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

faqs.question: Can I prepare for CUET PG 2026 exam in 2 months?
faqs.answer: Well it all depends on the individual. Some students takes time to prepare for CUET PG exam, about 6 months. But yes, you can do the preparation within 2 months also by executing a proper plan and making best of your ability.

faqs.question: What are the tips for candidates preparing for the CUET PG exam in CBT mode?
faqs.answer: Follow these tips: Get familiar with the format Practice taking CBT mock tests Understanding of computer skills Practice taking CBT mock tests.

faqs.question: What are some strategies to manage time effectively during the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Understand exam structure, practice within time limit, prioritise and strategise challenging questions, read very carefully.

faqs.question: What are some preparation Tips for Mediocre Students in CUET PG?
faqs.answer: Firstly, understand your strengths and weaknesses, then focus on the fundamentals, create a personalized study plan, set realistic goals, effective study techniques.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in Section B of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG 2026 exam pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions in total. Hence, the Section B will not be there.

faqs.question: What are the Masters courses offered through CUET PG?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 is a national-level entrance exam for candidates who wish to pursue their Masters degree from the central universities. From the past years, many other state, private, and deemed universities is participating in the CUET PG examination. The examination will offer admission to a range of master's courses including normal and professional degree courses: PG Courses Professional Degree Courses MA MSc MCA MCom MFA MBA LLB LLM BEd MEd

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in section A of CUET PG examination?
faqs.answer: As per the previous exam pattern of the CUET PG exam, there were 25 questions in Section A. As per the latest or the revised CUET PG pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions. The Section A or the General section has been removed since CUET PG 2025.

faqs.answer: Only those candidates who took the CUET PG exam will be able to download the provisional answer keys. However, the final answer keys of CUET PG accessible for all. faqs.question: Can Test takers raise objection against CUET PG answer key?
faqs.answer: Yes, test takers of CUET PG examination will get the oppurtunity to raise objection against the CUET PG provisional answer key. NTA will release the CUET PG 2026 provisional answer key on the official webiste of CUET PG 2026 within two weeks of the exam conclusion. The provisional answer key is released for all the subjects for which the CUET PG examination is conducted. Test-takers can visit the official website of CUET PG and login to their accounts using the username and password to see the Provisional answer key and CUET PG 2026 candidate's response sheet.

faqs.question: When will NTA release CUET PG 2026 final answer key?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 final answer key will be released in the first week of May 2026. CUET PG 2026 Results will be compiled based on the corrections made in the provisional answer key (also called CUET PG Final answer key). Candidates can check and download the CUET PG 2026 final answer key by logging in using their enrolment ID or email ID along with the password on the official website.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG passing marks?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Passing Marks are the scores or marks to be obtained to qualify for admission to the universities. If the candidate wants to know whether they have passed the CUET PG exam or not, they are required to check the cutoff marks released by the participating universities and colleges. After the declaration of the CUET PG result, all participating universities will release the course-wise passing marks or CUET PG cutoff, which will be used for shortlisting candidates for the counselling process.

faqs.question: What after CUET PG Result?
faqs.answer: Once result is downloaded candidates must preserve their CUET PG scorecard till admission process is concluded. CUET PG result includes several important details like candidate name, programme name, category, gender, qualification and eligibility.

faqs.question: What are the dates for CUET PG Results?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Result will be tentatively released in May 2026. Going by last year's trends, the exam will be conducted in a window of 15-20 days in March 2026. Followed by the release of the answer keys, the result will be declared in the first week of May 2026, on the exam website.

faqs.question: How to download CUET PG Result?
faqs.answer: Students need to follow the process given below to check the CUET PG result. Go to the website of CUET PG Click on the link indicating the CUET PG scorecard Log in with your CUET PG Application Number, password and date of Birth Enter the Security Pin and click on Submit Now you can download the CUET PG scorecard The CUET PG scorecard has to be preserved till the admission or counselling process is over. However, from the previous year academic year, they were able to choose a maximum of 20 test paper codes in all. What is Karunya MAT?

Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences conducts Kurunya MAT exam for MBA admission at the institute. Karunya MAT, also known as Karunya Management Aptitude Test is a university level entrance test held in multiple slots. The exam is conducted for 100 marks. Candidates will find a total of four sections in the Karunya MAT exam. Sections in Karunya MAT exam are similar to other MBA entrance exams like VARC, DILR, and Quant. In addition, candidates find questions on Indian and Global Business Environment.
Karunya MBA entrance exam is facilitated as a remote proctored exam.
Karunya MAT is conducted by Karunya Institute of Technology and Science (Deemed to be University). Candidates can apply for Karunya MAT exam from the official website of KITS.
Karunya MAT exam is conducted for MBA admission at Karunya Institute of Technology and Science. Candidates holding a UG degree can apply for Karunya KMAT exam.

Karunya MAT exam is conducted across five phases. Exam dates for each phase of Karunya MAT is different. Usually the first phase of Karunya MAT is held in January and the last phase of Karunya MAT takes place in July.
Karunya MAT exam has four sections with three being typical to other MBA exams, inlcuidng VARC, DILR, and QA. The fourth section in Karunya Management Aptitude Test is Indian and Global Environment.

ASBM University Entrance Examination (ASBMUEE) is common admission test conducted by the university for admission to its premier MBA programmes.

ASBMUEE is conducted twice a year in which candidates are evaluated on English, General Knowledge, and Reasoning Skills. blocks.value: IUET 2026: Integral University conducts a national level entrance test for admission to all its UG and PG courses (except BArch & MBBS, MD/MS courses). This national level entrance exam is called the Integral University Entrance Test (IUET) . However, candidates who qualify JEE Main/JEE Advanced/CMAT/UPCATET/AMUEEE/Uni-GAUGE/State Level Engineering Entrance Exams across India and entrance exams conducted by the prominent universities are exempted from IUET.

IUET is held in a computer-based test format at the University campus only, every Monday. The registered candidates will be notified of the exam date and time. The exam is held for 90 minutes from 10:00 am to 11:30 a.m. The exam consists of multiple choice questions, and the questions in the exam are based on the course for which the candidate applies.

To apply for IUET 2026 for Integral University admission, candidates can apply online at admission.iul.ac.in, or they can apply offline by obtaining forms from the Integral University campus or selected book stores. Check complete details on IUET 2026, like how to apply, eligibility, syllabus, pattern, selection process and more details on this page below.
What is IUET?
IUET is the Integral University Entrance Test. The exam is held in CBT mode for 90 minutes. It is conducted for admission to the following courses offered by Intergarl University:

value: M.Tech. (Computer Science & Engineering/Advanced Computing and Data Sc.)
M.Tech. (Instrumentation and Control/Power System Engineering/Power System and Drive)
M.Sc.(Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Medical Anatomy, Medical Physiology, Medical Biochemistry, Medical Microbiology)
Bachelor of Design (Product Design & Interior Design)
Post Graduation Diploma in Cyber Security & Law
Master of Science in Radio Imaging Technology
Master of Science in Forensic Science
Master of Arts in Clinical Psychology
Bachelor of Science in Medical Lab Technology
Master of Arts in Political Science

Bachelor’s in Anesthesiology and Intensive Care Technology
Post Graduate Diploma in Industrial safety & Management

Bachelor of Arts (Hons.) in Defense and Strategic Studies
Diploma in Anesthesia & Critical Care Technician
Diploma in Emergency Trauma & Care Technician
Diploma in Civil (Construction Management & Safety) Engineering
Certificate Program in Two Wheeler Technician (in association with Yamaha)
Diploma in Mechanical (Computer Aided Design) Engineering
Diploma in Mechanical (Refrigeration and Air Conditioning) Engg.
Diploma in Electronics & Electrical Engineering (Specialization in Electric Vehicle Technology)
Diploma in Electronics Computer Engineering Technology)

value: The candidates must have passed Class 12

Candidates whose result is awaited can also apply for IUET 2023

blocks.value: Admission to MBA programme of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University, Delhi will be held through CUET PG for the session 2023-24. Candidates desiring admission to the MBA programme must fill the CUET PG online application form online. The University has joined the Common University Entrance Test (CUET-PG) 2023 to be conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA).
What is AUD MBA Entrance Test ? (Scrapped)

School of Business, Public Policy & Social Entrepreneurship (AUD MBA Entrance Test) exam was conducted by Ambedkar University for admission to its 2-year (Full Time) MBA programme. Candidates willing to secure a seat in the University needed to clear the university entrance test. Candidates appearing for the entrance test will be assessed on Verbal Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, Data Interpretation, Reading Comprehension and General Awareness. Candidates who clear the entrance test will be further called for Personal Interview round.

Candidates must note that being called for the Personal Interview does not guarantee admission to the MBA programme offered by the University. The University will prepare a final list of selected candidates taking into account the scores obtained in the written test, and performance in the personal interview.
Take a look at the table below for the complete schedule of AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 exam

blocks.value: AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 Application Form

AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 registration will commence online. Candidates seeking admission to MBA programme must fill the application form online. The last date of registration is expected to be in last week of May 2023. Check the steps below to fill the AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 application form:

value: Click on the tab 'Online Application Form' and page will be redirected to the login page
Enter personal details to create login credentials
Candidates will recieve the mail from noreply@samarth.edu.in on their registered email address
Enter the OTP sent on the registered email address
Now, login to fill the application form of AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023
Pay the application fee of INR 1290 after entering the complete details

blocks.value: AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 Eligibility Criteria
As per the AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 eligibility criteria candidates must ensure to fulfill the following criteria:

value: Applicants must have a Bachelor's degree in nay discipline with minimum of 50% marks in aggregate from a recognised/statutory university/institution.
Candidates appearing in the final year of the bachelor's/post graduation degree examination will be apply, provided their admission will be on provisional basis until their results are declared.
5% relaxation will be given to the candidayes who are SC/ST/PwBD/D-OBC (NCL)/Defence candidates/Kashimiri Migrant candidates

Step 2- Download the admit card

Step 4- Decelaration of result
Step 5- Shortlisted candidates to appear for Personal Interview
Step 6- Final merit list will be released
AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 Syllabus

AUD MBA Entrance Test exam 2023 is similar to that of any other MBA entrance exam. Candiadtes preparing for AUD MBA Entrance Test exam must check the important topics to device effective prparation strategy. AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 syllabus will be divived across three sections viz., verbal ability (includes verbal aptitude and English language comprehension) and analytical ability (includes quantitative ability, data interpretation and logical reasoning) and general awareness.
AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 Exam Pattern

As per the AUD MBA Entrance Test exam pattern the exam is conducted in online mode. The duration of the exam is 150 minutes. The question paper will consist of total of 150 questions which will be divided across three sections. Check the table below to know the highlights for AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 exam pattern:
AUD MBA Entrance Test Pattern Highlights

value: Four marks for every correct answer

blocks.value: AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 Preparation Tips

AUD MBA Entrance Test is conducted for a duration of 2 hours 30 minutes. Knowing the time limit candidates must chalk out the AUD MBA Entrance Test preparation tips following the time limit and number of sections in the question paper.
1. Be thorough with the syllabus and exam pattern of AUD MBA Entrance Test
2. On the basis of the previous year question papers, candidates must mark the important topics and weightage for each
3. Analyse the preparation level with the help of mock tests and sample papers
4. Mark the strong and weak areas with the help of a mock test and prepare the timetable accordingly
5. Candidates must focus on the weak areas after revising the strong areas
6. Become part of study groups on social websites and discuss problem areas and questions.

Candidates will be able to download the admit card online from the official website of Dr. B.R.Ambedkar University. Candidates must enter the login credentials to access the hall ticket.
AUD MBA Entrance Test Question Papers

Candidates preparing for AUD MBA Entrance Test must download the question paper to become familiar with the exam pattern. AUD MBA Entrance Test question papers will help in analysing the preparation level and difficulty level of the exam.
AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023 Result

Authorities will declare the result for AUD MBA Entrance Test 2023soon after the exam is conducted. Candidates will be able to check their sectional as well as overall score. Candidates who will qualify the examination will have to appear for the personal interview round. The written test will carry the following weightage.

blocks.value: Admission to MBA programme of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University, Delhi will be held through CUET PG for the session 2023-24. Candidates desiring admission to the MBA programme must fill the CUET PG online application form online. The University has joined the Common University Entrance Test (CUET-PG) 2023 to be conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA).
What is AUD MBA Entrance Test ? (Scrapped)

School of Business, Public Policy & Social Entrepreneurship (AUD MBA Entrance Test) exam was conducted by Ambedkar University for admission to its 2-year (Full Time) MBA programme. Candidates willing to secure a seat in the University needed to clear the university entrance test. Candidates appearing for the entrance test will be assessed on Verbal Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, Data Interpretation, Reading Comprehension and General Awareness. Candidates who clear the entrance test will be further called for Personal Interview round.

Candidates must note that being called for the Personal Interview does not guarantee admission to the MBA programme offered by the University. The University will prepare a final list of selected candidates taking into account the scores obtained in the written test, and performance in the personal interview.

blocks.value: CMAT 2026 exam was held on January 25, 2026 in which 41,872 candidates appeared. NTA announced the CMAT 2026 result on February 17, 2026. The final CMAT answer key 2026 was also released on the same day. According to the final answer key, only one answer has been revised (question number 97). Total number of applications received this year was 53453. CMAT accepting colleges have opened registration window for admission. Read here all about CMAT 2026.
What is CMAT Exam?

CMAT is a national level entrance exam conducted by the NTA for admission to MBA/PGDM courses offered by AICTE recognized institutes. It is business aptitude test of 3 hours. CMAT question paper consists of 100 questions from Quantitative Techniques & Data Interpretation , Logical Reasoning , Language Comprehension, General Awareness and Innovation and Entrepreneurship. CMAT is a moderate difficulty level test and one can crack it with basic preparation. The questions are in MCQ format. CMAT score is also accepted for admission to Maharashtra State institutes through MAH CET CAP .
Also read: CMAT 2026 analysis

Ideally, one would say that 99 to100 percentile is good for MBA Admission. However, it is not possible for all candidates to score so high. So, what shall be considered a good score in CMAT. A good CMAT score is basically a score that will get you a seat in your desired college. So, if you desire a Tier 1 college, a good score in CMAT will be 85 percentile and above. If you desire a Tier 2 college, a good score in CMAT will be 70 to 85 percentile and for a Tier 3 college, less than 70 percentile in CMAT will be good. Now, if you want to understand CMAT. Score in terms of percentile, so that while giving the exam you know how much raw score is needed to get the required percentile for the desired college, you need to know how much CMAT score is equal to percentile. About 340 to 350 score is equal to 100 percentile in CMAT About 281to 340 score is equal to 90 to 99.99 percentile in CMAT About 201 to 280 score is equal to 81 to 89 percentile in CMAT About 171 to 200 score is equal to 71to 80 percentile in CMAT About 140 to 171 score is equal to 61 to 70 percentile in CMAT About 116 to 140 score is equal to 51 to 60 percentile in CMAT.

No, you cannot appear for the CMAT exam at any test centre. You can appear for the test at the centre mentioned in your CMAT admit card. Entry at every CMAT test centre is given to candidates only after thorough scrutiny of the hall ticket and ID proof. If you attempt to gain entry in any other test centre, you will be disqualified. Thus, candidates must make sure that they check the location of their allotted test centre beforehand and reach there on exam day on time.  If they reach the test centre after the gates have been closed they will not be allowed entry under any circumstances. CMAT test centre gates close 15 minutes before the commencement of exam.

CMAT 2026 Exam Highlights
CMAT scores are accepted by all AICTE approved institutions. About 75,000+ MBA aspirants appear for the CMAT exam every year. Check the table below for key aspects of CMAT 2026 exam :

For preparation of an exam like CMAT will always be helpful as you will be provided with relevant study material and guidance from industry experts. It will help you in disciplined and focused study as coaching centres have time bound classes, lectures, practice sessions, mock tests, etc. So, if you feel that you will not be able to stay dedicated and motivated enough in self-study to crack CMAT will high scores, join a CMAT coaching institute.

CMAT has five subjects – Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, English Comprehension, General Awareness and Innovation & Entrepreneurship and to cover all of them, one will need good enough time. Overall, 3 months are needed to cover syllabus of CMAT and about 2 to 3 months for practice and revision. So, overall 6 months are good for CMAT preparation.

blocks.value: After CMAT result has been declared, colleges accepting the exam score for MBA/PGDM admission will start the selection process. CMAT qualifying students will be required to fill the application forms of their target MBA colleges for admission. Colleges will select students on the basis of CMAT cut offs, and then will conduct GD/PI round for final selection.

It is not tough to score 99 percentile in CMAT but it is not a cake walk either. One need to study for the exam in a focused and time bound manner. It is speed based test in which time management is the key. One needs to also achieve maximum accuracy in solving CMAT questions to be able to aim for 99 percentile. Moreover, there is negative marking in CMAT, so one needs to be extremely careful in choosing questions in the exam.

There is no option of CMAT result evaluation. Scores mentioned on the CMAT scorecard are considered final. Candidates do have a chance to challenge the official CMAT answer keys on the basis of which results are prepared. CMAT provisional answer key is released a couple of days after the exam, and candidates can check offiicial answers. If they think any of the official answer is incorrect they can challenge it. The examination authority will review the answer key are revised the offiical answe key if required. The final scorecard will be prepared only after all objections have been reviewed.
CMAT Cut Offs and Top Colleges

CMAT cut offs 2026 will be determined by score accepting institutes individually. The cut offs for top colleges is usually in the range of 90-99 percentile. For Tier 2 colleges, the CMAT cut offs range between 60-80 and for Tier 3 colleges, the CMAT cut offs range between 50-70 percentile. blocks.value: CMAT Admission Process

CMAT admission process includes Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Some colleges conduct Written Ability Test (WAT) instead of GD. The CMAT score is accepted by many popular government and private colleges in India. These institutes select candidates on the basis of CMAT cut offs determined individually by their admissions department. To participate in the admission round, CMAT qualifiers have to fill the college admission forms of their preferred institute as per the deadline. Candidates can also use their CMAT score for MAH CET CAP to get admission to top Maharashtra colleges.
MBA admission through CMAT includes three main processes:

Aspirants must note that NTA has no role in MBA admission through CMAT. Score accepting college determine cut offs and selection criteria on their own, keeping essential government guidelines in mind.
Also Read : CMAT Selection and Admission Process

Check CMAT cut offs and predict calls from colleges accepting CMAT score for admission. Check Fees, Placement Reviews, Admission, Shortlist Criteria and Eligibility of all CMAT participating colleges by clicking the link below:

NTA does not release CMAT cut off. It has no role in release of CMAT cut off or admission through it. The CMAT cut offs are determined and released by score accepting colleges individually. The institutes either release CMAT cut off at the time of applications for admission or announce it during the PI shortlisting process.

CMAT score is not accepted by the IIMs. These institutes accept only CAT score for their management programmes. CMAT is accepted by over 1300 MBA colleges in India which belong to mostly Tier 2 and Tier 3 status. You can seek admission with CMAT score to all AICTE approved institutions – private, government and government aided.

1. Covering CMAT syllabus

Check here frequently asked questions (FAQs) about CMAT exam:

CMAT answer key objection fee is INR 200 per question. The objection will be accepted only if the fee has been paid successfully. Since CMAT objection fee is to be paid per question, it is advised that candidate should raise objection to answer keys of only those which they know are incorrect. Don't raise objection on answer keys that you are not sure of.

CMAT answer key is released 3-7 days after the exam. The exact date of CMAT exam answer key release is shared by the NTA in after the exam has been conducted. After the release of CMAT answer key, candidates can assess their performance, by tallying their responses and official answers. They can also challenge the official CMAT answer key, by filling an online form and uploading supporting documents. The NTA-CMAT will examine the objections to see if they are genuine or not. In case, the ojection/s are found to be valid, the CMAT answer key is revised and released as the final answer key. The CMAT result is prepared only after examination of all te objections received from candidates.

The provisional CMAT answer key is usually available for 2-3 days until the objection window is open. Candidates must download their CMAT response sheet and answer key within the objection window duration so that you don't miss the chance of having it, if the link is deactivated later. Post the result declaration, the provisional CMAT answer key may not be available for download.

With the CMAT answer key candidate can calculate their raw score but calculating accurate CMAT percentile may not be possible as, several factors are considered for CMAT percentile calculation, most important being normalised CMAT score and number of test takers.

The CMAT answer key objection fee is non-refundable. However, it will be refunded to only those candidates whose objections will be accepted as valid. Thus candidates must raise objection on answer keys only after careful deliberation and discussion with mentors/teachers. The fee amount will be refunded within 5-7 working days.

CMAT syllabus is somewhat same as CAT syllabus. It has two extra subjects, Innovation and Entrepreneurship and General Awareness. Yes, you should keep CMAT admit card safe even after exam, because you may be asked to present it at the time of admission. Signed and stamped CMAT admit card is a proof that candidate appeared in exam.

CAT cut offs hare higher than CMAT cut offs, due to various factors such as number of applicants, exam difficulty level, ranking of institutions, etc. CAT is conducted by IIM and is the toughest MBA entrance exam in India. Nearly 3 Lakh candidates appear for CAT exam and scores are accepted by some of the top ranking institutes. To select best of the best candidates CAT cut offs of IIMs and top colleges are very high. faqs.question: What is a good score in CMAT for admission to top MBA colleges?
faqs.answer: Ideally, one would say that 99 to100 percentile is good for MBA Admission. However, it is not possible for all candidates to score so high. So, what shall be considered a good score in CMAT. A good CMAT score is basically a score that will get you a seat in your desired college. So, if you desire a Tier 1 college, a good score in CMAT will be 85 percentile and above. If you desire a Tier 2 college, a good score in CMAT will be 70 to 85 percentile and for a Tier 3 college, less than 70 percentile in CMAT will be good. Now, if you want to understand CMAT. Score in terms of percentile, so that while giving the exam you know how much raw score is needed to get the required percentile for the desired college, you need to know how much CMAT score is equal to percentile. About 340 to 350 score is equal to 100 percentile in CMAT About 281to 340 score is equal to 90 to 99.99 percentile in CMAT About 201 to 280 score is equal to 81 to 89 percentile in CMAT About 171 to 200 score is equal to 71to 80 percentile in CMAT About 140 to 171 score is equal to 61 to 70 percentile in CMAT About 116 to 140 score is equal to 51 to 60 percentile in CMAT.

faqs.question: Can I appear for CMAT at any test centre?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot appear for the CMAT exam at any test centre. You can appear for the test at the centre mentioned in your CMAT admit card. Thus, candidates must make sure that they check the location of their allotted test centre beforehand and reach there on exam day on time.  If they reach the test centre after the gates have been closed they will not be allowed entry under any circumstances. CMAT test centre gates close 15 minutes before the commencement of exam.

faqs.answer: For preparation of an exam like CMAT will always be helpful as you will be provided with relevant study material and guidance from industry experts. faqs.question: What is the ideal time duration for CMAT preparation?
faqs.answer: CMAT has five subjects – Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, English Comprehension, General Awareness and Innovation & Entrepreneurship and to cover all of them, one will need good enough time. Overall, 3 months are needed to cover syllabus of CMAT and about 2 to 3 months for practice and revision. So, overall 6 months are good for CMAT preparation.

faqs.question: Does NTA conduct MBA Admission through CMAT?
faqs.answer:
No, the NTA doesn't conduct common counselling for admission through CMAT. The role of NTA viz. CMAT ends with result declaration. The CMAT accepting colleges conduct their own admission process individually. Candidates have to fill admission forms of the target colleges individually. The MBA colleges and universities accepting CMAT scores conduct group discussion and Personal Interview   to select candidates for admission. This selection is based on minimum CMAT cut off fixed by the institute. Admission through CMAT also includes assessment of candidates on the basis of other parameters such as academic record and work experience (not mandatory for all colleges). Overall, the admission process through CMAT includes selection of candidates on the basis of:
1. CMAT score
2. Class 10,  12 and graduation score
3. Work profile and other activities
4. Performance in Personal Interview   and group discussion
To check your chances of CMAT admission check this college predictor: https://www.shiksha.com/mba/cmat-college-predictor .

faqs.question: What after CMAT result?
faqs.answer: After CMAT result has been declared, colleges accepting the exam score for MBA/PGDM admission will start the selection process. CMAT qualifying students will be required to fill the application forms of their target MBA colleges for admission. Colleges will select students on the basis of CMAT cut offs, and then will conduct GD/PI round for final selection.

faqs.question: How to calculate CMAT percentile?
faqs.answer:
Since CMAT is usually conducted in two shifts, there are chances of the question paper of one shift being slightly tougher or easier in comparison to the question paper of other shift. In order to negate the possibility of any candidate having an advantage or disadvantage due to this, the exam authorities normalise the CMAT scores before percentile calculation. Once that is done, the authorities use the normalised score for percentile score calculation. CMAT percentile is basically a rank of a candidate vs the total number of candidates who appeared in the exam. Given below is the formula for calculating CMAT percentile prescribed by NT
Formula to Calculate CMAT Percentile:
If 10,000 candidates appeared in CMAT and only 1 candidate scored the highest marks (365/400). Since they have scored the highest in exam, their rank will be 1 and CMAT percentile score will be: 100 x 9999/10,000= 99.99.

faqs.question: Is it tough to score 99 percentiles in CMAT?
faqs.answer: It is not tough to score 99 percentile in CMAT but it is not a cake walk either. One need to study for the exam in a focused and time bound manner. It is speed based test in which time management is the key. One needs to also achieve maximum accuracy in solving CMAT questions to be able to aim for 99 percentile. Moreover, there is negative marking in CMAT, so one needs to be extremely careful in choosing questions in the exam.

faqs.question: Is there an option of CMAT result evaluation?
faqs.answer: There is no option of CMAT result evaluation. Scores mentioned on the CMAT scorecard are considered final. Candidates do have a chance to challenge the official CMAT answer keys on the basis of which results are prepared. CMAT provisional answer key is released a couple of days after the exam, and candidates can check offiicial answers. If they think any of the official answer is incorrect they can challenge it. The examination authority will review the answer key are revised the offiical answe key if required. The final scorecard will be prepared only after all objections have been reviewed.

faqs.question: Does NTA release CMAT cut off?
faqs.answer: NTA does not release CMAT cut off. It has no role in release of CMAT cut off or admission through it. The CMAT cut offs are determined and released by score accepting colleges individually. The institutes either release CMAT cut off at the time of applications for admission or announce it during the PI shortlisting process.

faqs.question: Is there any age restriction to take CMAT exam?
faqs.answer: There is no age bar for appearing in CMAT exam. Any person at any phase of their career, from any field, fresher or working professionals, can appear for CMAT. However, the candidate should have completed graduation. The education mode can be full-time or correspondence but the university should be affiliated to the UGC. A graduation degree is normally completed by the age of 20 so the candidate must be at least 20 years old at the time of appearing in the CMAT exam. So, yes one can say that there is a minimum age limit but not maximum age limit for appearing in CMAT. A large percentage of CMAT applicants is of fresh graduates as it suits them better to continue education in full-time mode. However, many working professional also appear for the CMAT exam to purse executive MBA, Online MBA, Distance MBA or Part-Time MBA from reputed institutes.

faqs.question: Is CMAT score accepted by IIMs?
faqs.answer: CMAT score is not accepted by the IIMs. These institutes accept only CAT score for their management programmes. CMAT is accepted by over 1300 MBA colleges in India which belong to mostly Tier 2 and Tier 3 status. You can seek admission with CMAT score to all AICTE approved institutions – private, government and government aided.

faqs.question: Is there a centralized counselling for admission through CMAT score?
faqs.answer:
No, there is no centralised counselling through CMAT. The national level entrance exam is conducted by the National Testing Agency for the AICTE. The role of NTA starts from framing exam pattern to registrations and ends with result announcement. After that, MBA colleges which accept CMAT score for shortlisting students start the selection process. There are about 1,300 MBA colleges in India which accept CMAT score for admission. All these colleges conduct admissions individually which includes, shortlisting of students on the basis of CMAT score, conduct of group discussion, written ability test and Personal Interview  and final selection based on certain parameters. Some common parameters for admission through CMAT include:
1. CMAT score
2. Class 10 and 12 scores
3. Graduation scores
4. Performance in group discussion and personal interview
5. Work experience (if any)
Final selection of candidates is based on these parameters. The admission cycle and application schedule of the CMAT accepting colleges can be different so aspirants are required to check admission related notification of the colleges regularly.

faqs.question: What is the CMAT marking scheme?
faqs.answer:
CMAT marking scheme is straightforward. If they can recall their attempts or have the answer key with them then they can calculate their CMAT raw score by adding and subtracting scores as per correct and incorrect attempts. Check CMAT marking scheme below:
1. For every correct attempt, 4 marks is awarded and for every incorrect answer, 1 mark is deducted. 
2. For every unanswered question, the candidate will be marked zero. Given below is the process of calculating the CMAT score with the help of the CMAT answer key. Every section has 20 questions, so suppose in Quantitative Techniques section you got 14 questions right, 2 questions wrong and skipped 4 questions. So, your score will be 54 out of 80. Similarly, calculate the score of other sections. After the add all five to arrive as overall raw score. For example, you scored 54, 44, 75, 60 and 40 in five sections, then your sum total will be 203/400. You can read more about CMAT scoring process here: https://www.shiksha.com/mba/articles/cmat-score-vs-percentile-how-to-calculate-blogId-19977 https://www.shiksha.com/mba/articles/what-is-cmat-score-normalization-process-blogId-53987 .

faqs.question: Is CMAT syllabus the same as that of CAT?
faqs.answer: Yes, syllabus of CMAT and CAT are same and include: 1. Quantitative Techniques and Data Interpretation: Mensuration Number System Algebra Time-Speed-Distance, Allegation and Mixtures, Geometry, Graph, Quadratic and Linear Equations, etc. 2. Logical Reasoning: Analytical Reasoning, Linear Arrangements, Number Series, Matrix Arrangements, Blood Relationship Tests, etc. 3. Language Comprehension: Reading Comprehension, Verbal Ability, Vocabulary, Grammar, English Usage Errors, Para jumbles, etc. However, CMAT has two extra sections - General Knowledge and Innovation and Entrepreneurship, topics of which are mentioned below: 4. General Awareness: Economy, Business, World, Politics, Sports, Culture, Society, Arts, Awards, Inventions 5. Innovation & Entrepreneurship: Questions related to innovation, entrepreneurship and start up business, models of entrepreneurship, Emerging Trends in Social Entrepreneurship, Entrepreneurial Society, Rural Entrepreneurship, etc.

faqs.question: What is the CMAT Innovation and entrepreneurship syllabus? Which books to study?
faqs.answer:
The syllabus of CMAT Innovation and entrepreneurship section includes Concepts of Entrepreneurship, Overview of Entrepreneurship, Evolution of Entrepreneurship in India, Role of Entrepreneurship in Economic Development, Theories and Models of Entrepreneurship, Framework of Entrepreneurship Theories, Models of Entrepreneurship, Emerging Models of Corporate Entrepreneurship, Dimensions of Entrepreneurship, Entrepreneurial Society, Entrepreneurial Culture, Rural Entrepreneurship, Women Entrepreneurship, Emerging Trends in Social Entrepreneurship, Principles of Business Organisation, Motivation, Communication and Leadership
To study these topics candidates should refer to books like:
1. Innovation & Entrepreneurship by Peter F. Drucker
2. Entrepreneurship & Innovation Management by R Goal
3. Entrepreneurship - Robert D. Hisrich 
4. Manorama Year Book - Mammen Mathew
Apart from these books, candidates must solve last two years' CMAT question papers to know the type of questions asked in this section and their difficulty level. These questions will give you an insight into CMAT Innovation and entrepreneurship.

faqs.question: Which are the best books for CMAT Quantitative Aptitude preparation?
faqs.answer:
The Quantitative Aptitude section of CMAT has questions from Arithmetic, Geometry, Modern Math, Numbers, Algebra and Data Interpretation. The questions are of moderate difficulty level and one can prepare for it with the help of best books for CMAT recommended by experts and toppers. We have listed down some of the popular CMAT books that candidates usually refer:
1. NCERT Mathematics Books for Class 8,  9 and 10 
2. The Pearson Guide to Quantitative Aptitude for Competitive Exams
3. How to Prepare for Quantitative Aptitude for CAT Arun Sharma (Mc Graw Hill Education)
4. Quantitative Aptitude Quantum CAT Common Admission Tests for Admission into Iims by Sarvesh K Verma (Arihant)
5. Quantitative Aptitude for Competitive Examinations by Abhijit Guha (Mc Graw Hill Education) 
6. Quantitative Aptitude for Competitive Exams by RS Aggarwal.

faqs.question: What are the items prohibited at the CMAT exam centre?
faqs.answer: No, any electronic item including the watch, mobile phone, ipad, calculator, watch, smartwatch, etc. Is not allowed inside the CMAT examination centre. Any candidate found carrying such an item inside the exam hall will be disqualified. Candidates can check time on the onscreen timer on their computer systems during the CMAT exam. Apart from electronic items, stationary other than a blue/black ball point pen, metal accessories or metal jewellery and eatables are not allowed. Caps & headgear, goggles, hoodies, shirt with pockets, pants with pockets and closed shoes are also not allowed inside the test centre. Any candidate found carrying any such item or pieces of paper will be disqualified from the exam. Candidates must not carry bags and other valuables, as CMAT exam centres do not have any provision of bag deposit.

faqs.question: For how long is CMAT city intimation slip available for download?
faqs.answer: CMAT city intimation slip is available for download for 2-3 days only. Once the CMAT admit card is released, the city intimation slip is not required as the hall ticket carries complete details of test centre. However, registered candidates must download the city intimation slip once it is released to know the test city and make arrangements for exam day before hand. City intimation is very useful specifically for students from rural and far off areas, who have to come to cities to appear for entrance exams.

faqs.question: Can I change my exam centre after the CMAT admit card has been issued?
faqs.answer: No. You cannot change the exam centre after the CMAT admit card has been issued. You cannot take the exam at any other centre other than the one mentioned in your admit card, either. So make an informed decision at time of selecting your test city in the CMAT application form. Select only those cities where you can make arrangement of stay on the CMAT exam day. Choose your home city or city of current residence as the first test city. The examination authorities try to allot the test centre to a candidate as per their first preference. However, sometimes if there are not enough number of applicants for a city, the centre may be cancelled there and candidates are allotted a test centre in the next city of preference. If at a particular exam centre in a city has already been filled with candidates, then the remaining students are allotted a test city in the next city of preference.

faqs.question: What details will be mentioned on the CMAT admit card?
faqs.answer:
The CMAT admit card is a main document of identification of the candidate who will be appearing in the exam. To ensure that a candidate doesn't use proxy candidate for taking the exam, admit card and original photo ID is checked at the exam centre. The personal details mentioned in the CMAT application from and photo ID, should reflect on the CMAT admit card too. The following details are mentioned on every candidate's CMAT admit card. Candidate's name
Candidate's roll number
Candidate's gender
Candidate's category
Candidate's date of birth
Candidate's signature
Candidate's photo
Candidate's address
Examination year
Examination date
Examination slot
Examination timings
Reporting time
Test centre address
Google link to locate test centre
Additional information such as exam day guidelines, examination process in the test lab, items to carry, items not to carry, activities prohibited, dress code and entry process are also mentioned on the CMAT hall ticket.

faqs.question: Are MAT and CMAT syllabi same?
faqs.answer: MAT and CMAT syllabi are same for Verbal Ability , Quantitative Aptitude, Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning. MAT also has GK like CMAT, but the nature of GK questions of MAT are slightly different from that of CMAT. The MAT GK section has more questions from economy and business.

faqs.question: Which is the lengthiest section in CMAT?
faqs.answer: Sectional weightage of CMAT is same. Since the Language Comprehension section of CMAT includes reading comprehension passages, it can be considered a lengthy section. However, any other section can also be lengthier due to nature of the questions.

faqs.question: Is there any negative marking in CMAT?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a negative marking in CMAT exam. For each wrong answer, 1 mark will be deducted. However, no marks will be deducted for unanswered questions.

faqs.question: How much time will be required to cover Innovation and Entrepreneurship syllabus of CMAT?
faqs.answer: Innovation and Entrepreneurship syllabus of CMAT is not a very difficult section. The syllabus pertains to business studies, economy and entrepreneurship. So, it will not require must time to cover the syllabus.  Candidate can dedicate one month to this section towards the end, while preparing for other sections. You can refer to books - Innovation and Entrepreneurship by Peter F. Drucker and Entrepreneurship & Innovation Management by R. Gopal, Entrepreneurship by Robert D. Hisrich and Manorama Year Book by Mammen Mathew.

faqs.question: Which are the top colleges for MBA with CMAT score of 65-75 percentile?
faqs.answer: Candidates with CMAT score of 65-75 percentile, must not feel bad about their comparatively low score. There are number of good MBA colleges in India which accept CMAT scores in this range for their postgraduate management courses. Some of the college that accept CMAT score of 65-75 percentile include, BIMTECH-Greater Noida, BIT-Mesra, DY Patil School of Management-Pune, DY Patil School of Management-Pune, Calcutta Business School, New Delhi Institute of Management (NDIM) New Delhi, Xavier Institute of Management and Entrepreneurship (XIME) Chennai, IES Management College And Research Centre, Mumbai, Jaipuria Institute of Management Noida, FIIB Delhi: Fortune Institute of International Business, Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (EDII Ahmedabad), VESIM Mumbai, Durgadevi Saraf Institute of Management Studies, Delhi School of Business, EMPI Business School New Delhi, Jaypee Business School (JBS) Noida, International Institute of Management Studies (IIMS) Pune among others.

faqs.question: How many questions should I solve to get a good score in CMAT?
faqs.answer: Since every section of CMAT has 20 questions in total, solving 15 to 18 questions in each section with 80 percent accuracy is considered a good attempt in CMAT, and it can ensure a good percentile in the exam. In the GK section, about 10 to 12 correct attempts will be enough. Out of 100 questions, candidates must try to solve about 70 to 75 questions to achieve a 99 percentile. However, candidates must aim to solve a higher number of questions with maximum accuracy and minimize negative marking. To be able to achieve this target, candidates have to prepare for the CMAT in a disciplined manner. Candidates must set aside about three months to complete the CMAT syllabus, as they have to study five subjects and their numerous topics. If they have appeared for CAT, XAT, and IIFT exams, then they can complete the CMAT syllabus in one month as well. However, it is advised that candidates spend at least three months on CMAT syllabus for complete preparation.

faqs.question: How many mock tests to attempt to score 99 percentile in CMAT?
faqs.answer: There is no particular number of CMAT mock test that you should target to solve during your preparation phase but on an average it has been seen that about 30-40 CMAT mock tests are good enough to score 99 percentile. Candidates must start solving CMAT mock tests after completing the syllabus as it will help them gauge which are the topics that they have understood well and which are the topics that require more work. 30-34 CMAT mock tests are recommended as, CMAT exam is all about speed and accuracy. The more questions you'll solve in an exam environment, the better you'll get at understanding, choosing and solving questions faster and correctly. Important point to note about practicing CMAT mock test is that one should analyse every mock test to understand the gaps and fissures and what to do to fill them. Another aspect to keep in mind is not to overdo it. When you start to score 98-99 percentile in CMAT mock tests consistently then you should stop and focus on revision, etc.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to colleges accepting CMAT score?
faqs.answer: Although there is no minimum graduation marks criterion for appearing in the CMAT exam, the criterion applies for admission through CMAT. As per the AICTE recommendation, the candidate must have completed graduation from a recognised university with a minimum score of 50 per cent in aggregate (45 per cent for Reserved category students) to be eligible for admission to a UGC recognised MBA/PGDM course.

faqs.question: How many cities can I choose for allotment of CMAT exam centre?
faqs.answer: Candidates can choose up to four cities for allotment of CMAT exam centre in the application form. Candidates must take utmost care in selecting the cities as once the form is submitted, they can't change city preference. They should choose the first city of preference as their hometome or where they are residing as the exam authorities will strive to allot the test centres to candidates in their first city of preference. Candidates are allotted a test centre in second or third preference only in a situation where the seats have been filled or the exam has been cancelled at that location. Choose cities very carefully as once selected the change can be made only at the time of form correction.

faqs.question: Can I download CMAT answer key after result has been released?
faqs.answer: It is unlikely that the CMAT answer key download link will be available even after the result has been released. The NTA may remove old links from the website after the CMAT result announcement. Thus, it is better to download the CMAT answer key on the day it is released and save a copy of the same.

faqs.question: Can I edit the CMAT application form after submission?
faqs.answer: Once you have submitted the CMAT application form, you cannot edit it. Thus, you will have to fill the CMAT form again by creating a new login ID and paying the fee again. However, if the mistake is in photo, signature or test centre fields, you can correct it at the time of form correction. The CMAT form correction window will be opened for three days after the conclusion of application form submission process.

faqs.question: Which documents are needed for CMAT application form filling?
faqs.answer:
The CMAT registration and form filling process is incomplete without submission of certain documents. Candidates need the following documents to fill the CMAT application form. While photo, signature and Certificate are to be uploaded with the form, other documents are required for making entries in it. 
1. Recent passport size photo (colour with white background)
2. Scanned signature on a white paper
3. Scanned copy of photo ID card such as Aadhaar card, PAN card, Voter ID card, Passport
4. Class 10 marksheet
5. Class 12 marksheet
6. Graduation marksheet
7. PG degree marksheet (if applicable)
8. Bank details
Candidates belonging to Reserved category are required to upload caste Certificate and candidates belonging to PwD category have to upload a Certificate for the same. They also need to upload scribe Certificate to avail the facility on the exam day. These Certificate formats can be downloaded from CMAT website.

faqs.question: Which are the top colleges for MBA with CMAT score of 65-75 percentile?
faqs.answer: Candidates with CMAT score of 65-75 percentile, must not feel bad about their comparatively low score. There are number of good MBA colleges in India which accept CMAT scores in this range for their postgraduate management courses. Some of the college that accept CMAT score of 65-75 percentile include, BIMTECH-Greater Noida, BIT-Mesra, DY Patil School of Management-Pune, DY Patil School of Management-Pune, Calcutta Business School, New Delhi Institute of Management (NDIM) New Delhi, Xavier Institute of Management and Entrepreneurship (XIME) Chennai, IES Management College And Research Centre, Mumbai, Jaipuria Institute of Management Noida, FIIB Delhi: Fortune Institute of International Business, Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (EDII Ahmedabad), VESIM Mumbai, Durgadevi Saraf Institute of Management Studies, Delhi School of Business, EMPI Business School New Delhi, Jaypee Business School (JBS) Noida, International Institute of Management Studies (IIMS) Pune among others.

faqs.question: Will I get admission if I meet CMAT cut off but not eligibility criteria of the college?
faqs.answer: It is quite unlikely that you can get admission if you do not meet the academic eligibility criteria for MBA. The basic criteria of selection are CMAT score and academic score. As per the AICTE, the minimum score required in graduation to qualify for MBA programme is 50 % (for SC/ST/PwD category, the minimum score requirement is 45%. So, MBA aspirants must ensure that they have scored at least 50 percent in their Bachelor's degree programme.

faqs.question: I scored less than 50 percent marks in Graduation. Am I eligible to apply for CMAT?
faqs.answer: Yes, you are eligible to apply for CMAT exam. Any candidate who has secured passing marks in graduation can apply for CMAT. Candidates must ensure that they have cleared graduation to be able to apply. Final year students planning to appear for the exam must ensure that they have passed the first two years of Bachelor's degree and must target passing marks in the final year as well. However, colleges accepting CMAT score for admission have a 50 per cent in graduation. The minimum score requirement for SC, ST, PwD candidates is 45 per cent as minimum criteria thus candidates must not target passing marks in graduation as even if they will clear CMAT. They might not get admission as they will not meet the institutes academic eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Is meeting CMAT cut off enough for MBA admission?
faqs.answer: Meeting CMAT cut off is the first stage of MBA admission. Candidates need to clear the Personal Interview/Group Discussion/Written Ability Test round too. Some institutes conduct only Personal Interview, some conduct Personal Interview/Group Discussion and some conduct all three, Personal Interview/Group Discussion/Written Ability Test. Apart from that, candidates must also meet the academic criteria for selection.

faqs.question: What is the CMAT answer key objection fee?
faqs.answer: CMAT answer key objection fee is INR 200 per question. The objection will be accepted only if the fee has been paid successfully. Since CMAT objection fee is to be paid per question, it is advised that candidate should raise objection to answer keys of only those which they know are incorrect. Don't raise objection on answer keys that you are not sure of.

faqs.question: When does CMAT answer key release?
faqs.answer: CMAT answer key is released 3-7 days after the exam. The exact date of CMAT exam answer key release is shared by the NTA in after the exam has been conducted. After the release of CMAT answer key, candidates can assess their performance, by tallying their responses and official answers. They can also challenge the official CMAT answer key, by filling an online form and uploading supporting documents. The NTA-CMAT will examine the objections to see if they are genuine or not. In case, the ojection/s are found to be valid, the CMAT answer key is revised and released as the final answer key. The CMAT result is prepared only after examination of all te objections received from candidates.

faqs.question: Till when is provisional CMAT answer key available for download?
faqs.answer: The provisional CMAT answer key is usually available for 2-3 days until the objection window is open. Candidates must download their CMAT response sheet and answer key within the objection window duration so that you don't miss the chance of having it, if the link is deactivated later. Post the result declaration, the provisional CMAT answer key may not be available for download.

faqs.question: Will I be able to calculate my CMAT percentile with CMAT answer key?
faqs.answer: With the CMAT answer key candidate can calculate their raw score but calculating accurate CMAT percentile may not be possible as, several factors are considered for CMAT percentile calculation, most important being normalised CMAT score and number of test takers.

faqs.question: Is the CMAT answer key objection fee refundable?
faqs.answer: The CMAT answer key objection fee is non-refundable. However, it will be refunded to only those candidates whose objections will be accepted as valid. Thus candidates must raise objection on answer keys only after careful deliberation and discussion with mentors/teachers. The fee amount will be refunded within 5-7 working days.

faqs.question: Does CMAT city intimation slip have test centre details?
faqs.answer: The CMAT city intimation slip mentions only the name of city in which test centre has been allotted to the candidate. No other information is given on the CMAT city intimation slip. Details regarding the test centre, exam timings, reporting time. etc. are mentioned on the CMAT admit card only.

faqs.question: Is CMAT syllabus easier than CAT syllabus?
faqs.answer: CMAT syllabus is somewhat same as CAT syllabus. It has two extra subjects, Innovation and Entrepreneurship and General Awareness. However, these two subjects are not tough and can be covered alongside Quantitative Aptitude, English and Logical Reasoning. Despite having less subjects CAT is tougher than CMAT.

faqs.question: Do I have to preserve the CMAT admit card even after the exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, you should keep CMAT admit card safe even after exam, because you may be asked to present it at the time of admission. Signed and stamped CMAT admit card is a proof that candidate appeared in exam.

faqs.question: Why are CAT cut offs higher than CMAT cut offs?
faqs.answer: CAT cut offs hare higher than CMAT cut offs, due to various factors such as number of applicants, exam difficulty level, ranking of institutions, etc. CAT is conducted by IIM and is the toughest MBA entrance exam in India. Nearly 3 Lakh candidates appear for CAT exam and scores are accepted by some of the top ranking institutes. To select best of the best candidates CAT cut offs of IIMs and top colleges are very high. CMAT on the other hand is a moderate difficulty level exam and nearly 75000 candidates appear for it. It is accepted mostly by Tier 2 and Tier 3 colleges.

What is CMAT Exam?

CMAT is a national level entrance exam conducted by the NTA for admission to MBA/PGDM courses offered by AICTE recognized institutes. It is business aptitude test of 3 hours. CMAT question paper consists of 100 questions from Quantitative Techniques & Data Interpretation , Logical Reasoning , Language Comprehension, General Awareness and Innovation and Entrepreneurship. CMAT is a moderate difficulty level test and one can crack it with basic preparation. The questions are in MCQ format. CMAT score is also accepted for admission to Maharashtra State institutes through MAH CET CAP .
Also read: CMAT 2026 analysis

Ideally, one would say that 99 to100 percentile is good for MBA Admission. However, it is not possible for all candidates to score so high. So, what shall be considered a good score in CMAT. A good CMAT score is basically a score that will get you a seat in your desired college. So, if you desire a Tier 1 college, a good score in CMAT will be 85 percentile and above. If you desire a Tier 2 college, a good score in CMAT will be 70 to 85 percentile and for a Tier 3 college, less than 70 percentile in CMAT will be good. Now, if you want to understand CMAT. Score in terms of percentile, so that while giving the exam you know how much raw score is needed to get the required percentile for the desired college, you need to know how much CMAT score is equal to percentile. About 340 to 350 score is equal to 100 percentile in CMAT About 281to 340 score is equal to 90 to 99.99 percentile in CMAT About 201 to 280 score is equal to 81 to 89 percentile in CMAT About 171 to 200 score is equal to 71to 80 percentile in CMAT About 140 to 171 score is equal to 61 to 70 percentile in CMAT About 116 to 140 score is equal to 51 to 60 percentile in CMAT.

Entry at every CMAT test centre is given to candidates only after thorough scrutiny of the hall ticket and ID proof. If you attempt to gain entry in any other test centre, you will be disqualified. Thus, candidates must make sure that they check the location of their allotted test centre beforehand and reach there on exam day on time.  If they reach the test centre after the gates have been closed they will not be allowed entry under any circumstances. CMAT test centre gates close 15 minutes before the commencement of exam.

The CMAT score is accepted by many popular government and private colleges in India. These institutes select candidates on the basis of CMAT cut offs determined individually by their admissions department. To participate in the admission round, CMAT qualifiers have to fill the college admission forms of their preferred institute as per the deadline. Candidates can also use their CMAT score for MAH CET CAP to get admission to top Maharashtra colleges.

faqs.question: What is a good score in CMAT for admission to top MBA colleges?
faqs.answer: Ideally, one would say that 99 to100 percentile is good for MBA Admission. However, it is not possible for all candidates to score so high. So, what shall be considered a good score in CMAT. A good CMAT score is basically a score that will get you a seat in your desired college. So, if you desire a Tier 1 college, a good score in CMAT will be 85 percentile and above. If you desire a Tier 2 college, a good score in CMAT will be 70 to 85 percentile and for a Tier 3 college, less than 70 percentile in CMAT will be good. Now, if you want to understand CMAT. Score in terms of percentile, so that while giving the exam you know how much raw score is needed to get the required percentile for the desired college, you need to know how much CMAT score is equal to percentile. About 340 to 350 score is equal to 100 percentile in CMAT About 281to 340 score is equal to 90 to 99.99 percentile in CMAT About 201 to 280 score is equal to 81 to 89 percentile in CMAT About 171 to 200 score is equal to 71to 80 percentile in CMAT About 140 to 171 score is equal to 61 to 70 percentile in CMAT About 116 to 140 score is equal to 51 to 60 percentile in CMAT.

faqs.question: Does NTA conduct MBA Admission through CMAT?
faqs.answer:
No, the NTA doesn't conduct common counselling for admission through CMAT. The role of NTA viz. CMAT ends with result declaration. The CMAT accepting colleges conduct their own admission process individually. Candidates have to fill admission forms of the target colleges individually. The MBA colleges and universities accepting CMAT scores conduct group discussion and Personal Interview   to select candidates for admission. This selection is based on minimum CMAT cut off fixed by the institute. Admission through CMAT also includes assessment of candidates on the basis of other parameters such as academic record and work experience (not mandatory for all colleges). Overall, the admission process through CMAT includes selection of candidates on the basis of:
1. CMAT score
2. Class 10,  12 and graduation score
3. Work profile and other activities
4. Performance in Personal Interview   and group discussion
