faqs.question: How can I reach to SHIATS exam centre if I live in Delhi?
faqs.answer: If ypu live in Delhi you can choose the SHIATS entrance exam centre in the city itself. The SHIATS entrance exam 2026 will be held in different states across the nation and among those states one state is New Delhi.

faqs.question: Where is the exam centre exactly located for SHIATS exam?
faqs.answer: The main campus is of Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology and Sciences (SHUATS) is in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.

faqs.question: What are the important features in SHIATS 2026 Entrance Exam?
faqs.answer: Students are advised to go thorugh the SHIATS entrance exam 2026 highlights and important features for having a better clarity of the exam: Particulars Details Exam Name SHIATS Entrance Exam Full Form Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology & Sciences Entrance Exam Exam Level National Level Conducting Body Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology & Sciences Exam Mode Online Exam Duration 2 hours SHIATS 2026 Exam Date July 2026 (Tentative)

faqs.question: On what parameters a candidate's admission to SHIATS courses will be refused?
faqs.answer: Candidates who are interested in taking the admissions to one of the courses offered at SHIATS, will be refused on the following parameters: If any candidate is found misleading the University with false marks, mark sheet,  information and been admitted in the University, the University reserves the right to reject the admission and further debar the candidate from seekingadmission in  the University in future. It is the responsibility of the candidate to furnish complete and correct information in the application form. Any admission made on the basis of wrong or concealed information provided by the candidate or due to any oversight or error of the online counselling and admission division which is subsequently detected after the admission or joining of the candidate, will be cancelled at any time at the cost and the risk of the candidate. Candidates against whom disciplinary action has been taken and who have been involved in any sort of established criminal offence in the past, will not be considered for admission. If admission of a candidate is not in the interest of the university, the ViceChancellor reserves the right to cancel the admission of such a student, irrespective of the fact that he / she fulfils all the academic requirement of the programme. The decision of Vice- Chancellor shall be final and legally binding on the candidate.

faqs.question: How are seats divided in SHIATS Entrance Exam Admission based on the candidate's origin?
faqs.answer: Category of candidates and their allocation of seats in SHIATS etntrance exam is based on the following norms: Regular Students: Candidates selected for admission into various academic programmes offered by the university are considered as fulltime regular students. These students will be entitled to avail of all the facilities of the various academic departments and other fields in the university. Christian and General Candidates: University reserves 50% seats for candidates of the Christian community and the remaining 50% seats shall be allotted to general candidates. Thus,  the total number of seats of the university have been categorized equally for Christian and general candidates. The total number of seats for admission in undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are given. Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Candidates: For the academic programmes in agriculture, agricultural engineering and allied sciences, fifteen percent (15%) seats in undergraduate programmes and twenty-five percent (25%) seats in postgraduate programmes will be filled through all India entrance test conducted by ICAR, New Delhi. However, eighty-five percent (85%) seats in undergraduate and seventyfive percent (75%) in postgraduate shall be filled by SHUATS. The ICAR category seats are inclusive of Christian and general candidates and the number filled in either category shall be adjusted against total seats in each category. Foreign Candidates: Foreign candidates are not required to appear in SOET / merit based offline counselling / open online counselling. Admission to foreign candidates will be given on the recommendation of the Directorate of International Education and Training. The foreign candidates shall pay fees in U.S. dollars as mentioned in Table No. 9 of Prospectus 2023, which does not include the boarding and lodging (food expenses etc.) charges. Non-resident Indian (NRI) Candidates: i. Admission for NRI wards/NRI-sponsored candidates is available in all undergraduate, postgraduate and Ph.D programmes. ii. NRI wards/NRI sponsored candidates are exempted from the merit based online counselling / open online counselling. iii. These admissions shall be against fifteen percent (15%) over and above seats available for various academic programmes.

faqs.question: What is the SHIATS 2026 Merit List?
faqs.answer: Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology & Sciences releases separate merit lists as part of SHIATS result. S. No. SHIATS Merit List 1 Separate merit lists are prepared for each category (Christian & general) basis total marks obtained by the candidate in SHIATS entrance exam result. 2 Separate merit lists under each category (Christian and general) for undergraduate, postgraduate, BEd and MEd as per application form number will be displayed on the notice boards of the university as well as official university website of SHUATS. 3 Out of the eligible programmes under the Subject Group Code for UG and Subject Group Number for PG programmes, the candidate will be provisionally admitted in only one programme, strictly on the basis of merit and availability of seat in the respective programme under Christian/ general category of seats. 4 The NRI Wards/ NRI-sponsored candidates shall be admitted on the basis of a separate merit list prepared exclusively for them. These admissions shall be against 15% over and above the seats available in various academic programmes. 5 15% seats in undergraduate programmes and 25% seats in postgraduate programmes in agricultural and allied subjects will be allotted through All India Entrance Test conducted by ICAR, New Delhi.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for SHIATS counselling?
faqs.answer: Students who clear the shiats entrance exam are elgible to sit for the counselling session. They should clear the minimum requirement they have.

faqs.question: What is SHIATS 2026 counselling?
faqs.answer: The SHIATS 2026 counse;ing process is when the qualified candidates who cleared the exam sit in the counselling sessions in which they have been alloted with the colleges as per their scores.

faqs.question: How to Complete SHIATS 2026 Online Merit Counselling?
faqs.answer: Students can follow the tips on how to complete SHIATS online merit counselling process: Student must first visit website of SHIATS. On home page under Admissions tab click on UG Merit List. Enter application number to see if you have made merit list or not. Student will then have to click on Merit Based Counselling. On clicking link student will have to enter their application form number and query code. Student will then have to upload their documents and make payment of fees online. Once transaction is made student has secured admission to the course applied for.

faqs.question: Is there any age limit for the SHIATS entrance exam 2026?
faqs.answer: Absolutely not there is no age limit to appear in the SHIATS entrance exam 2026 .

faqs.question: Is SHIATS affiliated to Allahabad University?
faqs.answer: No SHIATS is not affiliated with the Allahabad University; it is an independent private university that was established by an act of Uttar Pradesh Legislature in 2016.

faqs.question: What is the format of SHIATS exam, and what type of questions can candidates expect?
faqs.answer: SHIATS Entrance Exam is a multiple choice exam consisting of 100 questions. The questions are divided into 3 sections: 1. Physics: 30 questions 2. Chemistry: 30 questions 3. Mathematics: 40 questions Each question carries 1 mark NO negative marking. Conducted in offline mode for duration of 1.5 hours. The types of questions that candidates can expect in SHIATS Entrance Exam are: 1. Physics 2. Chemistry 3. Mathematics

What is HBSAT?

Hyderabad Business School Aptitude Test (HBSAT) is conducted by Hyderabad Business School , GITAM University , Hyderabad Campus. The exam is a gateway for admission to its two-year full-time MBA programme approved by UGC, All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of HRD, Govt. of India, New Delhi.
The HBSAT 2020 dates have not been announced yet, however, going by previous year’s trend, the exam is likely to be held in January 2020.
Eligibility Criteria for HBSAT 2020
HBSAT 2020 eligibility criteria is as follows:

value: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any stream or equivalent, with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks or equivalent in any discipline.
Candidates in their final year of their Bachelor's Degree or equivalent can also apply, provided they furnish the proof of having met the minimum eligibility criteria.
Candidates with valid MAT / GMAT / CAT / XAT / ATMA / NMAT scores are exempted from HBSAT
Foreign students and NRI sponsored candidates are also eligible, and are required to take the GMAT at a test centre outside India.

blocks.value: HBSAT 2020 Highlights
Admission Process: HBSAT 2020
Step 1: Fill in the HBSAT Application form
Aspirants who wish to appear for the exam need to fill HBSAT application form on the official website of Hyderabad Business School, Gitam University.
The application fee can be paid in the following modes:
Step 2: Download HBSAT 2020 Admit Card

The HBSAT admit card will be issued to the candidates online. To download the admit cards candidates need to visit the official website and enter the registration number and Date of Birth. Candidates must keep in mind that the admit card is an important document that needs to be carried to the exam hall.
Step 3: Appear for HBSAT 2020 exam

The exam is likely to be held in January, 2020 and will be conducted in online mode. The HBSAT 2020 exam will have questions from Data sufficiency, Mathematical Ability, Communication & Business Aptitude, English, and Reasoning.
Step 4: Check HBSAT 2020 Result

HBSAT result 2020 is expected to be declared within one month from the date of exam. The result will be displayed on the official website. To check the same, candidates need to visit the official website and click on the link reflecting ‘Result’. The result will be display in pdf format. Candidates are advised to take a printout of the same.
Step 5: Group Discussion & Personal Interview

Test-takers who qualify the exam will be called for the Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. The final selection of students will be done on the basis of the scores obtained in the HBSAT/national level exams, GD & PI.
Step 6: Counselling

Once the final list of students selected for admission is prepared, a counselling session will be conducted. Candidates must note that it is important to be present in person for the HBSAT counselling .
HBSAT 2020: Exam Centres
While GITAM Campus, Hyderabad is a default test centre , if there are at least ten applicants from one of the following areas, GD & PI will be conducted in the below mentioned cities:

Candidates appearing for the HBSAT exam must carry the following documents to get entry inside the exam hall:

value: Admit card: Candidates appearing for the HBSAT 2020 exam must carry their admit cards to the exam centre. You will not be allowed entry in case you do not carry your HBSAT admit card
Identity Proof: Along with the admit card, candidates are required to carry a photo ID proof such as College ID, employer ID, driving license, passport, PAN card, voter ID, Aadhaar card

Hyderabad Business School Aptitude Test (HBSAT) is conducted by Hyderabad Business School , GITAM University , Hyderabad Campus. The exam is a gateway for admission to its two-year full-time MBA programme approved by UGC, All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of HRD, Govt. of India, New Delhi.
The HBSAT 2020 dates have not been announced yet, however, going by previous year’s trend, the exam is likely to be held in January 2020.
Eligibility Criteria for HBSAT 2020
HBSAT 2020 eligibility criteria is as follows:

value: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any stream or equivalent, with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks or equivalent in any discipline.
Candidates in their final year of their Bachelor's Degree or equivalent can also apply, provided they furnish the proof of having met the minimum eligibility criteria.
Candidates with valid MAT / GMAT / CAT / XAT / ATMA / NMAT scores are exempted from HBSAT
Foreign students and NRI sponsored candidates are also eligible, and are required to take the GMAT at a test centre outside India.

blocks.value: HBSAT 2020 Highlights
Admission Process: HBSAT 2020
Step 1: Fill in the HBSAT Application form
Aspirants who wish to appear for the exam need to fill HBSAT application form on the official website of Hyderabad Business School, Gitam University.
The application fee can be paid in the following modes:
Step 2: Download HBSAT 2020 Admit Card

The HBSAT admit card will be issued to the candidates online. To download the admit cards candidates need to visit the official website and enter the registration number and Date of Birth. Candidates must keep in mind that the admit card is an important document that needs to be carried to the exam hall.
Step 3: Appear for HBSAT 2020 exam

The exam is likely to be held in January, 2020 and will be conducted in online mode. The HBSAT 2020 exam will have questions from Data sufficiency, Mathematical Ability, Communication & Business Aptitude, English, and Reasoning.
Step 4: Check HBSAT 2020 Result

HBSAT result 2020 is expected to be declared within one month from the date of exam. The result will be displayed on the official website. To check the same, candidates need to visit the official website and click on the link reflecting ‘Result’. The result will be display in pdf format. Candidates are advised to take a printout of the same.
Step 5: Group Discussion & Personal Interview

Test-takers who qualify the exam will be called for the Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. The final selection of students will be done on the basis of the scores obtained in the HBSAT/national level exams, GD & PI.
Step 6: Counselling

Once the final list of students selected for admission is prepared, a counselling session will be conducted. Candidates must note that it is important to be present in person for the HBSAT counselling .
HBSAT 2020: Exam Centres
While GITAM Campus, Hyderabad is a default test centre , if there are at least ten applicants from one of the following areas, GD & PI will be conducted in the below mentioned cities:
Exam Day Guidelines
Candidates appearing for the HBSAT exam must carry the following documents to get entry inside the exam hall:

value: Admit card: Candidates appearing for the HBSAT 2020 exam must carry their admit cards to the exam centre. You will not be allowed entry in case you do not carry your HBSAT admit card
Identity Proof: Along with the admit card, candidates are required to carry a photo ID proof such as College ID, employer ID, driving license, passport, PAN card, voter ID, Aadhaar card

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

The CUET PG preparation should start at least a year before the exam. Hence, students in their final year of college should start by knowing about the exam, followed by identifying the strengths and weaknesses, writing mock tests, to begin with.

Check the syllabus: NTA provides a detailed syllabus for each subject. Before starting the preparation, students should go through the topics and chapters. The syllabus is designed in line with the curriculum of the Bachelor's degree courses or equivalent.

Get the right books and study materials: Generally, the college textbooks and study materials are sufficient for preparing for CUET PG 2026 . But students may look for subject-specific notes and guidebooks available in the market, published specifically for CUET PG preparation .

Solve previous years CUET PG question papers: The CUET PG question papers for the past years are released by NTA. Students are advised to download and solve them to gain an in-depth understanding of the question types and topics covered.

Take CUET PG mock tests: Taking CUET PG mock tests in an exam-specific environment and duration will act as the core for preparation. CUET PG mocks are provided by coaching institutes as well as NTA. Writing mock tests will not only help students in practising the questions, but also in other aspects, such as managing time and deciding the test-taking methods. faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.
As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.
CUET PG 2026 Preparation

The CUET PG preparation should start at least a year before the exam. Hence, students in their final year of college should start by knowing about the exam, followed by identifying the strengths and weaknesses, writing mock tests, to begin with.

value: Know the exam: First and foremost, know the exam pattern, in terms of duration, number and type of questions and marking scheme.
Select the papers or subjects: Next, select the subject or papers you want to opt for. According to NTA, students can select up to four test papers. Based on that, the preparation has to be done.

Check the syllabus: NTA provides a detailed syllabus for each subject. Before starting the preparation, students should go through the topics and chapters. The syllabus is designed in line with the curriculum of the Bachelor's degree courses or equivalent.

Get the right books and study materials: Generally, the college textbooks and study materials are sufficient for preparing for CUET PG 2026 . But students may look for subject-specific notes and guidebooks available in the market, published specifically for CUET PG preparation .

Solve previous years CUET PG question papers: The CUET PG question papers for the past years are released by NTA. Students are advised to download and solve them to gain an in-depth understanding of the question types and topics covered.

Take CUET PG mock tests: Taking CUET PG mock tests in an exam-specific environment and duration will act as the core for preparation. CUET PG mocks are provided by coaching institutes as well as NTA. Writing mock tests will not only help students in practising the questions, but also in other aspects, such as managing time and deciding the test-taking methods. After the mock tests, it is equally important to get the performance analysed by teachers to improve the performance.

faqs.question: What are some important instructions regarding CUET PG admit card?

In case a candidate is unable to download his/ her CUET PG admit cards from the website, he or she may approach the Help Line 011 40759000 between 9.30 am to 5.30 pm or write an email to NTA. It is mandatory to get the admit card of CUET PG 2026 signed by a parent/guardian. It is mandatory to carry a valid photo ID proof on the day of CUET PG 2026. Candidates have to carry a passport-sized photograph on the day of the examination. This photograph has to be affixed to the attendance sheet. In case of any discrepancy in the particulars of the candidate or his/her photograph and signatures shown on the Admit Card and Confirmation Page, the candidate may immediately approach the Help Line between the timings given above. In such cases, candidates would appear in the Examination with the already downloaded Admit Card. However, NTA will take necessary action to make corrections in the record later.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: What are some strategies to manage time effectively during the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Understand exam structure, practice within time limit, prioritise and strategise challenging questions, read very carefully.

faqs.question: What are some preparation Tips for Mediocre Students in CUET PG?
faqs.answer: Firstly, understand your strengths and weaknesses, then focus on the fundamentals, create a personalized study plan, set realistic goals, effective study techniques.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in Section B of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG 2026 exam pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions in total. Hence, the Section B will not be there.

faqs.question: What are the Masters courses offered through CUET PG?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 is a national-level entrance exam for candidates who wish to pursue their Masters degree from the central universities. From the past years, many other state, private, and deemed universities is participating in the CUET PG examination. The examination will offer admission to a range of master's courses including normal and professional degree courses: PG Courses Professional Degree Courses MA MSc MCA MCom MFA MBA LLB LLM BEd MEd

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in section A of CUET PG examination?
faqs.answer: As per the previous exam pattern of the CUET PG exam, there were 25 questions in Section A. As per the latest or the revised CUET PG pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions. The Section A or the General section has been removed since CUET PG 2025.

faqs.question: How to download CUET PG Answer Key?
faqs.answer: Only those candidates who took the CUET PG exam will be able to download the provisional answer keys. However, the final answer keys of CUET PG accessible for all. The steps to download and check the CUET PG answer keys are given below: Visit the CUET PG website Click on the text or link indicating Answer Key Log in with application number and date of birth Enter the Security Pin given on screen and click on Submit Check and download the provisional answer keys of CUET PG

faqs.question: Can Test takers raise objection against CUET PG answer key?
faqs.answer: Yes, test takers of CUET PG examination will get the oppurtunity to raise objection against the CUET PG provisional answer key. NTA will release the CUET PG 2026 provisional answer key on the official webiste of CUET PG 2026 within two weeks of the exam conclusion. The provisional answer key is released for all the subjects for which the CUET PG examination is conducted. Test-takers can visit the official website of CUET PG and login to their accounts using the username and password to see the Provisional answer key and CUET PG 2026 candidate's response sheet.

faqs.question: When will NTA release CUET PG 2026 final answer key?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 final answer key will be released in the first week of May 2026. CUET PG 2026 Results will be compiled based on the corrections made in the provisional answer key (also called CUET PG Final answer key). Candidates can check and download the CUET PG 2026 final answer key by logging in using their enrolment ID or email ID along with the password on the official website.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG passing marks?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Passing Marks are the scores or marks to be obtained to qualify for admission to the universities. If the candidate wants to know whether they have passed the CUET PG exam or not, they are required to check the cutoff marks released by the participating universities and colleges. After the declaration of the CUET PG result, all participating universities will release the course-wise passing marks or CUET PG cutoff, which will be used for shortlisting candidates for the counselling process.

faqs.question: What after CUET PG Result?
faqs.answer: Once result is downloaded candidates must preserve their CUET PG scorecard till admission process is concluded. CUET PG result includes several important details like candidate name, programme name, category, gender, qualification and eligibility.

faqs.question: What are the dates for CUET PG Results?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Result will be tentatively released in May 2026. Going by last year's trends, the exam will be conducted in a window of 15-20 days in March 2026. Followed by the release of the answer keys, the result will be declared in the first week of May 2026, on the exam website.

faqs.question: How to download CUET PG Result?
faqs.answer: Students need to follow the process given below to check the CUET PG result. Go to the website of CUET PG Click on the link indicating the CUET PG scorecard Log in with your CUET PG Application Number, password and date of Birth Enter the Security Pin and click on Submit Now you can download the CUET PG scorecard The CUET PG scorecard has to be preserved till the admission or counselling process is over. The validity of the CUET PG result is one year.

faqs.question: How many subjects can be opted in CUET PG while filling the application form?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 examination will be scheduled in March 2026. Aspirants preparing for the CUET PG exam could fill the online application form from December 14 to January 23, 2026. While filling up the CUET PG online application form, test taker can select only one subject in one slot of the examination day. However, from the previous year academic year, they were able to choose a maximum of 20 test paper codes in all. Before choosing multiple subjects for the examination, candidates are advised to check the minimum education eligibility criteria for the particular course they have applied for. Also, check the university-specific subject criteria for the subject a candidate wants to appear for.

faqs.question: Does Faculty of Law, BHU accept CUET-PG score for LLM admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Faculty of Law, BHU accepts CUET-PG scores for admission to LLM courses. Candidates seeking admission must have a valid score in the national-level examination. In 2025, the cutoff marks for the one-year LLM and two-year LLM courses stood at 187 and 185 , respectively. The mentioned cutoff was for the applicants belonging to the General All-India category.

faqs.question: How many universities accept CUET PG scores?
faqs.answer: Approximately 200 universities across India accept the CUET PG scores. The exam scores will be used to grant admission to the postgraduate or master's degree courses across multiple streams. After the result is declared, these universities will conduct their admission process separately. There is no common counselling process for the CUET PG participating universities. Candidates have to qualify for the CUET PG exam and meet the eligibility criteria for admission to the CUET PG participating universities.

faqs.question: What are the steps for CUET PG 2026 Counselling Process?
faqs.answer: After the CUET PG 2026 result declaration, the Participating Universities will separately release their merit list or shorlisted candidate's list who are selected for participating in the counselling process for that college. Depending on the availability of vacant seats at that particular university of any course, the CUET PG counselling rounds will vary. But as per the previous year trend, candidates can expect at least two rounds of counselling for any course at one of the participating universities.

faqs.question: Who conducts CUET PG Counselling?
faqs.answer: Although NTA, National Testing Agency is the CUET PG 2026 examination conducting body but the CUET PG 2026 Counselling process is not conducted by NTA. The candidates should note that the City Intimation Slip is different from the admit card and it inform only about the exam city.

Last date to submit CUET application form 2026 online was January 23, 2026. It must be noted, CUET PG hall ticket 2026 will be uploaded online and students will have to download hall ticket for CUET PG 2026 with login details. NTA will release CUET PG 2026 admit card a few days after city slip. Read this article to know CUET PG 2026 dates, syllabus, pattern and preparation tips.

Admit Card : Feb ' 26

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG exam pattern?

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG exam pattern?

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

Students can choose up to four subjects in the CUET PG 2026 exam. The choice of subjects would depend on the course studied in graduation and the universities opted for.

The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.
As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.
CUET PG 2026 Preparation

The CUET PG preparation should start at least a year before the exam. Hence, students in their final year of college should start by knowing about the exam, followed by identifying the strengths and weaknesses, writing mock tests, to begin with.

value: Know the exam: First and foremost, know the exam pattern, in terms of duration, number and type of questions and marking scheme.
Select the papers or subjects: Next, select the subject or papers you want to opt for. According to NTA, students can select up to four test papers. Based on that, the preparation has to be done.

Check the syllabus: NTA provides a detailed syllabus for each subject. Before starting the preparation, students should go through the topics and chapters. The syllabus is designed in line with the curriculum of the Bachelor's degree courses or equivalent.

Get the right books and study materials: Generally, the college textbooks and study materials are sufficient for preparing for CUET PG 2026 . But students may look for subject-specific notes and guidebooks available in the market, published specifically for CUET PG preparation .

Solve previous years CUET PG question papers: The CUET PG question papers for the past years are released by NTA. Students are advised to download and solve them to gain an in-depth understanding of the question types and topics covered.

Take CUET PG mock tests: Taking CUET PG mock tests in an exam-specific environment and duration will act as the core for preparation. CUET PG mocks are provided by coaching institutes as well as NTA. Writing mock tests will not only help students in practising the questions, but also in other aspects, such as managing time and deciding the test-taking methods. After the mock tests, it is equally important to get the performance analysed by teachers to improve the performance.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

blocks.value: What is CUET PG

CUET PG 2026 is one of the most important exams held for admisison into postgraduate courses in various streams including science, Humanities, Engineering, Management, Law, etc. Exam is held for admissiin into central, state, and private universities. Around 4 to 5 lakh appear for CUET PG exam. Since its launch in 2022, CUET has become most popular exam at PG level. CUET PG 2026 scores will be accepted by prominent institutes like the University of Delhi, TISS, JNU, BHU , etc., for their master's degree course admissions.

The exam will be conducted for admission to multiple postgraduate courses, such as MSc, MA, MCom, MBA, MTech, LLM, etc. The subjects or papers of CUET PG are segregated into Science, Humanities, MTech, Language, Acharya and Common. The papers or subjects of MBA, MCom, Law, etc. are included under the 'Common' subject.
Here is why you can opt for CUET PG 2026:

1. Easy Admission Process (One exam, many Universities): Before CUET PG, if a student wanted to study postgraduate education, they used to have to appear for the entrance examination for each university. Each with their own syllabus, pattern and application process, etc., but with CUET PG, you can apply to many universities and courses, with one single uniform test. This has helped greatly in saving students about 90 per cent of time, money and effort.

2. Fair and Standardised Evaluation: Here are some of the factors of evaluation, which are followed by NTA. • Standard evaluation • Normalisation technique applied since it is conducted for multiple days and slots • Less reliance on Board score - CUET PG keeps the focus off the board exam percentages, and provides subject-based knowledge and aptitude, bringing parity to students from different educational backgrounds ( CBSE , ICSE , state boards). 3. Transparent and Efficient: NTA Conducting the Process: The National Testing Agency is an Autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education that conducted CUET PG, leading to efficient, transparent and internationally standardised testing.

Students can download CUET PG syllabus of respective stream online. NTA uploads syllabus PDF at official website. Syllabus can be downloaded by visiting exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg/syllabus and selecting respective stream.

As per the statistics shared by the exam conducting authority, National Testing Agency, approximately four Lacs candidates appear for the CUET PG every year. Science, Humanities and Linguistics have the highest number of candidates.

Students can choose up to four subjects in the CUET PG 2026 exam. The choice of subjects would depend on the course studied in graduation and the universities opted for.

CUET PG 2026 Exam: The CUET PG 2026 exam will be conducted over multiple days and slots for different subjects or papers. Candidates can appear for up to four papers. The subjects will be scheduled in such a manner that they do not clash. C UET PG exam dates 2026 were announced online. Exam is schedule from March 6, 2026.

CUET PG 2026 Answer Key: NTA will release the provisional CUET PG 2026 answer keys around a week after the exam. Students will be able to submit challenges within the given date. Based on the objections, the final answer key and result will be prepared.
CUET PG Results 2026: The CUET PG results will be announced online a few weeks after the answer key release. The scorecard will mention the marks obtained in subjects along with their All India Rank.

CUET PG Counselling: The CUET PG counselling process will be conducted separately by the participating institutes. Candidates have to follow the instructions and formalities to get the seats allotted.

faqs.question: What are some important instructions regarding CUET PG admit card?
faqs.answer: Candidates should keep in mind the following information in mind during and after downloading the CUET PG 2026 admit card. Candidates have to carry a passport-sized photograph on the day of the examination. This photograph has to be affixed to the attendance sheet. In case of any discrepancy in the particulars of the candidate or his/her photograph and signatures shown on the Admit Card and Confirmation Page, the candidate may immediately approach the Help Line between the timings given above. In such cases, candidates would appear in the Examination with the already downloaded Admit Card. However, NTA will take necessary action to make corrections in the record later.

faqs.question: How is CUET PG examination monitored at the exam centres?
faqs.answer: • A Central Control Room was opened to monitor and facilitate the smooth conduct of the Examination on the ground. 02 National Coordinators,  19 Regional Coordinators,  303 City Coordinators,  1083 Observers, and 162 Deputy Observers were deployed. • Live CCTV Surveillance was planned in all examination centres to curb malpractices in the examination. The NTA also made arrangements for live viewing of remote locations of all examination centres from the Control Room located in the NTA premises of New Delhi. Recording of CCTV Systems was also done. • The examination centres were also monitored using AI-based Video Analytics and Virtual Observers. • In order to stop cheating using mobile networks, Jammers were installed in all the Centres.

faqs.question: Is CUET PG held twice a year?

faqs.question: What was date of release of CUET PG Application Form 2026?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 application form was released on December 14, 2025 online. Last date to submit application form for CUET PG 2026 was January 23, 2026. It must be noted NTA only accept online applications for CUET PG exam.

faqs.question: Can CUET PG Applications filled offline?
faqs.answer: No. CUET PG applications are accepted in online mode only. NTA, the exam conducting body doesn't accept any offline application form for CUET exam. If someone sends application by any offline modes such as Fax or by hand, that will not be accepted.

faqs.question: How many city preferences one can fill out in CUET PG Application form?
faqs.answer: For the CUET PG 2026 exam, candidates could fill out a maximum of four city preferences. Although initially, NTA announced the selection of two exam cities, as per a later notification, candidates could choose four exam cities in their present or permanent address.

faqs.question: What is the CUET PG application fee for NRI students?

faqs.question: What is the format of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET PG exam is conducted in a computer-based mode. The format of the questions is objective type. There are 75 multiple choice questions with four options. With the help of a mouse, students have to mark the correct answer option and click on Save and Next to move to the next question. They can also mark a question for review. The CUET PG exam screen will show the total number of attempted, unattempted, and marked for review questions. Candidates can also move forward and backward with the help of mouse.

faqs.question: What is CUET PG exam pattern?
faqs.answer: NTA will do some minor changes in the CUET PG exam pattern. Now the exam duration of the CUET PG exam will be 90 minutes instead of 105. There will be 75 MCQ questions asked from the candidates domain knowledge. The exam will be conducted in online/CBT mode in a bilingual medium.

faqs.question: What is the total marks in the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Total marks of the CUET PG exam is 300. The number of questions in the exam is 75. Each question carries four marks. One mark is removed for each wrong answer. There is a single section. All questions are asked from the subject or paper opted for.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of CUET PG?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG marking scheme, four marks are awarded for each correct answer. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. There is no negative marking for unanswered questions.

faqs.question: Can I prepare for CUET PG 2026 exam in 2 months?
faqs.answer: Well it all depends on the individual. Some students takes time to prepare for CUET PG exam, about 6 months. But yes, you can do the preparation within 2 months also by executing a proper plan and making best of your ability.

faqs.question: What are the tips for candidates preparing for the CUET PG exam in CBT mode?
faqs.answer: Follow these tips: Get familiar with the format Practice taking CBT mock tests Understanding of computer skills Practice taking CBT mock tests.

faqs.question: What are some strategies to manage time effectively during the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: Understand exam structure, practice within time limit, prioritise and strategise challenging questions, read very carefully.

faqs.question: What are some preparation Tips for Mediocre Students in CUET PG?
faqs.answer: Firstly, understand your strengths and weaknesses, then focus on the fundamentals, create a personalized study plan, set realistic goals, effective study techniques.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in Section B of the CUET PG exam?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET PG 2026 exam pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions in total. Hence, the Section B will not be there.

faqs.question: What are the Masters courses offered through CUET PG?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 is a national-level entrance exam for candidates who wish to pursue their Masters degree from the central universities. From the past years, many other state, private, and deemed universities is participating in the CUET PG examination. faqs.answer: As per the previous exam pattern of the CUET PG exam, there were 25 questions in Section A. As per the latest or the revised CUET PG pattern, there is only one section, carrying 75 questions. The Section A or the General section has been removed since CUET PG 2025.

faqs.question: When will NTA release CUET PG 2026 final answer key?
faqs.answer: CUET PG 2026 final answer key will be released in the first week of May 2026. faqs.question: What is CUET PG passing marks?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Passing Marks are the scores or marks to be obtained to qualify for admission to the universities. faqs.question: What are the dates for CUET PG Results?
faqs.answer: CUET PG Result will be tentatively released in May 2026. Going by last year's trends, the exam will be conducted in a window of 15-20 days in March 2026. Followed by the release of the answer keys, the result will be declared in the first week of May 2026, on the exam website.

faqs.answer: Students need to follow the process given below to check the CUET PG result. blocks.value: CMAT 2026 exam was held on January 25, 2026 in which 41,872 candidates appeared. NTA announced the CMAT 2026 result on February 17, 2026. The final CMAT answer key 2026 was also released on the same day. According to the final answer key, only one answer has been revised (question number 97). Total number of applications received this year was 53453. CMAT accepting colleges have opened registration window for admission. Read here all about CMAT 2026.
What is CMAT Exam?

CMAT is a national level entrance exam conducted by the NTA for admission to MBA/PGDM courses offered by AICTE recognized institutes. It is business aptitude test of 3 hours. CMAT question paper consists of 100 questions from Quantitative Techniques & Data Interpretation , Logical Reasoning , Language Comprehension, General Awareness and Innovation and Entrepreneurship. CMAT is a moderate difficulty level test and one can crack it with basic preparation. The questions are in MCQ format. CMAT score is also accepted for admission to Maharashtra State institutes through MAH CET CAP .
Also read: CMAT 2026 analysis

Ideally, one would say that 99 to100 percentile is good for MBA Admission. However, it is not possible for all candidates to score so high. So, what shall be considered a good score in CMAT. A good CMAT score is basically a score that will get you a seat in your desired college. So, if you desire a Tier 1 college, a good score in CMAT will be 85 percentile and above. If you desire a Tier 2 college, a good score in CMAT will be 70 to 85 percentile and for a Tier 3 college, less than 70 percentile in CMAT will be good. Now, if you want to understand CMAT. Score in terms of percentile, so that while giving the exam you know how much raw score is needed to get the required percentile for the desired college, you need to know how much CMAT score is equal to percentile. About 340 to 350 score is equal to 100 percentile in CMAT About 281to 340 score is equal to 90 to 99.99 percentile in CMAT About 201 to 280 score is equal to 81 to 89 percentile in CMAT About 171 to 200 score is equal to 71to 80 percentile in CMAT About 140 to 171 score is equal to 61 to 70 percentile in CMAT About 116 to 140 score is equal to 51 to 60 percentile in CMAT.

No, you cannot appear for the CMAT exam at any test centre. You can appear for the test at the centre mentioned in your CMAT admit card. Entry at every CMAT test centre is given to candidates only after thorough scrutiny of the hall ticket and ID proof. If you attempt to gain entry in any other test centre, you will be disqualified. Thus, candidates must make sure that they check the location of their allotted test centre beforehand and reach there on exam day on time.  If they reach the test centre after the gates have been closed they will not be allowed entry under any circumstances. CMAT test centre gates close 15 minutes before the commencement of exam.

It will help you in disciplined and focused study as coaching centres have time bound classes, lectures, practice sessions, mock tests, etc. So, if you feel that you will not be able to stay dedicated and motivated enough in self-study to crack CMAT will high scores, join a CMAT coaching institute.

CMAT has five subjects – Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, English Comprehension, General Awareness and Innovation & Entrepreneurship and to cover all of them, one will need good enough time. CMAT qualifying students will be required to fill the application forms of their target MBA colleges for admission. Colleges will select students on the basis of CMAT cut offs, and then will conduct GD/PI round for final selection.

It is not tough to score 99 percentile in CMAT but it is not a cake walk either. One need to study for the exam in a focused and time bound manner. It is speed based test in which time management is the key. One needs to also achieve maximum accuracy in solving CMAT questions to be able to aim for 99 percentile. Moreover, there is negative marking in CMAT, so one needs to be extremely careful in choosing questions in the exam.

There is no option of CMAT result evaluation. Scores mentioned on the CMAT scorecard are considered final. Candidates do have a chance to challenge the official CMAT answer keys on the basis of which results are prepared. CMAT provisional answer key is released a couple of days after the exam, and candidates can check offiicial answers. If they think any of the official answer is incorrect they can challenge it. faqs.question: How to calculate CMAT percentile?
faqs.answer:
Since CMAT is usually conducted in two shifts, there are chances of the question paper of one shift being slightly tougher or easier in comparison to the question paper of other shift. In order to negate the possibility of any candidate having an advantage or disadvantage due to this, the exam authorities normalise the CMAT scores before percentile calculation. Once that is done, the authorities use the normalised score for percentile score calculation. CMAT percentile is basically a rank of a candidate vs the total number of candidates who appeared in the exam. Given below is the formula for calculating CMAT percentile prescribed by NT
Formula to Calculate CMAT Percentile:
If 10,000 candidates appeared in CMAT and only 1 candidate scored the highest marks (365/400). Since they have scored the highest in exam, their rank will be 1 and CMAT percentile score will be: 100 x 9999/10,000= 99.99.

faqs.question: Is it tough to score 99 percentiles in CMAT?
faqs.answer: It is not tough to score 99 percentile in CMAT but it is not a cake walk either. One need to study for the exam in a focused and time bound manner. faqs.question: What is the CMAT marking scheme?
faqs.answer:
CMAT marking scheme is straightforward. If they can recall their attempts or have the answer key with them then they can calculate their CMAT raw score by adding and subtracting scores as per correct and incorrect attempts. Check CMAT marking scheme below:
1. For every correct attempt, 4 marks is awarded and for every incorrect answer, 1 mark is deducted. 
2. For every unanswered question, the candidate will be marked zero. Given below is the process of calculating the CMAT score with the help of the CMAT answer key. Every section has 20 questions, so suppose in Quantitative Techniques section you got 14 questions right, 2 questions wrong and skipped 4 questions. So, your score will be 54 out of 80. Similarly, calculate the score of other sections. After the add all five to arrive as overall raw score. For example, you scored 54, 44, 75, 60 and 40 in five sections, then your sum total will be 203/400. You can read more about CMAT scoring process here: https://www.shiksha.com/mba/articles/cmat-score-vs-percentile-how-to-calculate-blogId-19977 https://www.shiksha.com/mba/articles/what-is-cmat-score-normalization-process-blogId-53987 .
