Candidates must follow the course criteria to select the CUET subjects and align with the subjects studied in class 12th.

faqs.question: Is Mathematics compulsory for CUET UG?
faqs.answer: No, Mathematics is not a compulsory subject to appear for CUET UG exam. NTA conducts CUET UG exam for 13 languages,  23 domain subjects and general test. Candidates can choose any five subjects based on the course and college criteria. CUET Mathematics can be opted if the course criteria suggests.

faqs.question: Is CUET UG exam compulsory?
faqs.answer: Common University Entrance Test is compulsory for admission to the undergraduate programme of central universities. Candidates must have a valid score in CUET UG exam to get admission in desired course and college. Some CUET state and private universities conduct own entrance test and also accept CUET UG scores.

faqs.question: Who can avail the scribe facility for CUET UG?
faqs.answer: PwD candidates who are visually impaired or have disability in the upper limb or have lost hands/fingers which prevents them from operating the CUET UG computer based test will be able to avail the scribe facility. Such candidates can take the help of scribe for reading the questions or keying the answers as per the direction of candidate. The scribe will not be allowed to explain or suggest the answer. To avail the service of scribe, PwD candidates must opt for it while filling the CUET 2026 application form.  The scribe will be provided by CUET 2026 conducting body National Testing Agency (NTA) only.

faqs.question: Is it important to select CUET subjects studied in class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is important for students to align the CUET UG subjects with the subjects studied in class 12th. Top central universities like Delhi University, does not accept CUET subject scores which have not been studied by student in class 12th. While selecting CUET subjects candidates must make sure that CUET subjects must closely or completely align with the subjects studied in class 12th. Failing which, candidate will be disqualified for admission despite a good score.

faqs.question: I have forgotten my CUET application number. How can I login for CUET application form?
faqs.answer: If a candidate has forgotten his/her CUET application number, it can be retrieved by following the steps below: Check registered email ID and phone number for SMS as It includes CUET application form number on successful registration. Check the saved page of CUET application form. or, Candidates may contact at NTA to know their CUET application form number. After getting the CUET application number, students must ensure to note it somewhere for future login process. CUET application form number is required to login and download the admit card or results when released.

faqs.question: How many subjects can a candidate choose in CUET UG while filling the application form?
faqs.answer: The numbers for choosing CUET subjects are five out of the 37 options available. Refer to the table below for more details on CUET subject choices. Section 1A (13 languages) Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Odia, Bengali, Assamese, Punjabi, English, Hindi, and Urdu. faqs.question: Which are the non editable details in CUET application form?
faqs.answer: Candidates will not be able to edit the following details in the CUET 2026 application form once submitted: Mobile number Email address Permanent and correspondence address Emergency contact details

faqs.question: What is the total score in CUET UG?
faqs.answer: CUET UG total marks is 250 Marks for each subject. Candidates can choose up to five CUET subjects. Each subject paper has 50 questions which will total to 250 marks for each subject. For every correct answer, candidate will get 5 marks. The CUET total marks will be uniform for all 37 subjects. The Total CUET subjects marks can vary depending on the number of subjects chosen by candidates. If three CUET subjects chosen: 750 total marks If four CUET subjects chosen: 1000 total marks If five CUET subjects chosen: 1250 total marks

faqs.question: When to apply for CUET exam 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates can re-apply for CUET exam 2026. NTA has reopned the CUET application form 2026 online window. Candidates must make sure to have registered for CUET exam and select appropriate CUET subjects to be eligible for admissions. CUET UG application form 2026 re-commenced on February 23 and will be open till February 26.

faqs.question: From where can I download CUET sample papers?
faqs.answer: Common University Entrance Test (CUET) sample papers are released by the conducting body, National Testing Agency (NTA). To download the CUET question papers follow the steps below: Go to- CUET Question Paper Select CUET subject to download the question paper for Click on the tab download Create the login details for new registrations Link to download the CUET question paper will be sent on the registered email ID Click on the link provided and save the PDF.

faqs.question: What is the latest pattern for CUET UG exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates can see the table showing the latest CUET UG exam pattern 2026 below - Section Number of Questions Duration Language 50 60 Minutes Domain Specific 50 General Test 50 Note: The exam pattern is taken from official website of the conducting body and can be changed if instructed by it. Hope this helps your query! All the best!

faqs.question: Will CUET UG exam duration vary for each subject?
faqs.answer: No, CUET UG exam duration will not vary for each subject. The exam duration will be unform for all CUET subjects that is 60 minutes. Candidates will be required to attempt 50 questions within the given time limit. The marking scheme of each question remains the same.

faqs.question: What type of questions are asked in the CUET exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET questions are objective in nature and carries four options also known as MCQs. Candidates will have to choose the correct answer option and click on it with the help of mouse. Since CUET UG 2026 exam will be conducted in a CBT mode, test-takers will be able to mark only one answer option. In case it is the correct option, students will get +5 marks and in case of wrong answer, negative marking scheme will be applied. Hence, candidates must ensure the accuracy of the answer before selecting the answer.

faqs.question: How many subjects can I choose for the CUET exam?
faqs.answer: From CUET UG 2026 onwards, candidates can now choose for five CUET subjects. Earlier, the subject choices were six. With the rediuction in number of CUET subjects, the choices have been reduced. Candidates can opt for five subjects from 23 domain subjects of any stream irrespective of subjects studied in class 12th.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of the CUET exam?
faqs.answer: The difficulty level of the CUET exam varies between moderate and tough. Since the CUET UG exam is held for multiple subjects and slots, the difficulty level of the exam varies from subject to subject. Sometimes, the difficulty level may also vary for different slots. While for the well-prepared candidates, the difficulty level will be low, for the underprepared students, the level of difficulty will be on the higher side.

faqs.question: Which are the languages included in CUET UG?
faqs.answer: CUET UG langauge section will now consist of 13 languages instead of 33 languages. The 13 langauges of CUET UG 2026 are: English, Hindi, Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu. Whereas, the languages which have been deleted are: Arabic, Bodo, Chinese, Dogri, French, German, Italian, Janpanese, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili, Manipuri, Nepali, Persian, Russian, Santhali, Sindhi, Spanish, Tibetan, Sanskrit.

faqs.question: What is CUET exam duration for each subject?
faqs.answer: CUET UG exam pattern have three sections. Section I- 13 Languages Section II- 23 Domain Subject Section III- General Test Candidates will get 60 minutes for each language, domain subject and language. Candidates will not be given extra time

faqs.question: What special facilities are provided to PwD candidates to appear for CUET exam?
faqs.answer: As per the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment guidelines, PwD candidates will be provided with following facilities: Scribe facility : In case the candidate has physical limitation and required a scribe for writing the exam, he/she must be certified in the format provided by CMO/Civil Surgeon/ Medical Superintendent of a Government Health Care Institution. Extra time : PwD candidates will get extra time of one hour whether such candidates use scribe facilities or not.

faqs.question: Does NTA releases the CUET mock test?
faqs.answer: National Testing Agency is expected to release CUET UG mock test at nta.ac.in. If released, candidates can appear for CUET mock test by following steps below: Visit official link og NT nta.ac.in Click on tab 'Mock Test' Now select exam name Select paper name Click on 'Start Mock Test'

faqs.question: Is it compulsory to attempt all the sections of the CUET question paper?
faqs.answer: CUET UG question paper for each subject will consist of 50 questions. Candidates will be required to attempt all questions and no optional questions will be provided. In CUET UG 2026 there are 37 subjects- 13 languages, 23 domain subjects and general tests. While filling the CUET application form, candidates can select upto five CUET subjects aligning with the subjects studied in class 12th and course requirement. Candidates must attempt all the questions of the subjects selected. However, candidates must keep in mind the negative marking and select the options carefully.

faqs.question: Which are the central universities accepting CUET UG scores?

faqs.question: Which IIT accepts CUET score?
faqs.answer: CUET UG scores are not accepted by IITs. Common University Entrance Test for UG is conducted for admission to state, central, private, deemed and government institutions. Admission to UG courses of IITs is offered through other national level entrance examinations.

faqs.question: How many universities accept CUET score?
faqs.answer: Common University Entrance Test (CUET) score 2026 will be accepted by more than 205 universities (central, state, private and deemed) across India. On the basis of the CUET UG score, candidates are offered admission to UG programme of the participating colleges. Candidates applying for admission to UG programme must ensure to check the course eligibility criteria before filling the application form. Some of the top CUET accepting universities with NIRF ranking 2024 are: Name State NIRF Rank 2024 Jawaharlal Nehru University Delhi 2 Jamia Millia Islamia Delhi 3 Banaras Hindu University Uttar Pradesh 5 University of Delhi Delhi 6 Aligarh Muslim University Uttar Pradesh 8

faqs.question: Is CUET UG college list released?
faqs.answer: NTA has released the CUET UG 2026 college and universities list. Candidates preparing for CUET UG 2026 can check the list of CUET accepting colleges 2026 at cuet.nta.nic.in. More than 250 universities are accepting CUET scores for admission to 2026-27 academic year. Candidates can now check the university-wise UG courses and eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Which are top central universities accepting CUET score?
faqs.answer: The top central universities accepting CUET UG scores are: NIRF 2- Jawaharlal Nehru University NIRF 4- Jamia Millia Islamia NIRF 6- Banaras Hindu University NIRF 5- University of Delhi NIRF 10- Aligarh Muslim University

faqs.question: What is CUET result date?
faqs.answer: NTA will announce the CUET result 2026 tentatively in first week of July. CUET UG result 2026 will be announced at cuet.nta.nic.in online. Candidates who will appear for the exam can check their scores online. Students will be required to enter their login credentials to view the CUET scorecard 2026. NTA will mention the applicant's details and subject-wise score for CUET 2026. The scores will be sent to the universities for which candidates have applied soon after the declaration of results. Candidates must note that the role of NTA ends soon after the declaration of CUET results 2026.

faqs.question: Is 700 a good score in CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, 700 is a good score in CUET. This score can help candidates place in top colleges of Delhi University, banaras Hindu University and Allahabad University. 700 score is considered to a CUET good score creating a percentile of 95+.

faqs.question: What is CUET UG cut off for top courses?
faqs.answer: CUET UG cut off will vary from course to course and universities. To know the cut off for CUET UG courses, candidates must stay updated with the notification released by the universities for admissions. As per the previous year analysis, candidates can expect the CUET UG cut off for various top courses under Arts, Commerce and Science as mentioned below: University CUET cutoff link Delhi University CUET DU Cutoff Allahabad University CUET AU cutoff Banaras Hindu University CUET BHU cutoff

faqs.question: How to mark using CUET answer key?
faqs.answer: After downloading the CUET provisional answer key, candidates must also download CUET response sheet. Candidates must match answers marked on the response sheet. While marking correct answers, candidates must follow marking scheme mentioned below: +5 marks will be given for every correct answer 1 mark will be deducted for every incorrect answer

faqs.question: What if the question is dropped and answer key is revised in CUET UG?
faqs.answer: If the question is dropped or the answer key is revised, NTA will give score as If multiple options are correct then students who marked any correct option will get five marks. If all options provided are correct then all students who gave answer will be given five marks. If none of the options is correct, a question is wrong, or a question is removed then all students who attempted the removed question will get five marks.

faqs.question: When will the CUET final answer key be released?
faqs.answer: National Testing Agency will release the CUET 2026 final answer key before the announcement of results. NTA releases the revised CUET answer key based on the objections received at cuet.nta.nic.in. Candidates are given opportunity to challenge the CUET UG answer key 2026 within a three-day window. The date to challenge the answer key will be notified. Only paid challenges made during the stipulated period will be considered. CUET answer key challenges without justification/evidence, and those filed on any other medium other than the prescribed link for CUET UG will not be considered. CUET UG 2026 results will be compiled based on the final answer key. Candidates will not get the outcome of the challenges received.

faqs.question: When will CUET result be declared?
faqs.answer: CUET result 2026 will be declared tentatively in first week of July 2026. Candidates who will appear for the exam can download their CUET scorecard online when released. The link to download the CUET scorecard will be available at CUET results 2026 . Candidates will be required to enter the login credentials to view the CUET 2026 scorecard online. CUET scores are used for admission to various universities/colleges that candidates has applied for while filling the application form. Candidates must download and take the print of the CUET 2026 results when released. CUET UG 2026 exam will be held from May 11 to May 31.

faqs.question: Are candidates required to apply separately for all the universities of CUET UG for counselling?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates seeking admission through CUET UG are required to apply separately to each university's counseling process through university portal. National Testing Agency conducts CUET examination but does not conduct counseling or admission process. Each CUET UG participating university conducts its own counseling rounds based on CUET scores and their specific admission criteria.

faqs.question: I am class 12th board topper. Do I need to participate in CUET UG counselling? Or will I be offered direct admission in central university?
faqs.answer: Yes, you will have to appear for the CUET counselling rounds of the central universities. Admission to central universities is offered based on CUET UG scores. Candidates must note that class 12th marks will not be considered for final admission to UG courses of central universities. Class 12th marks are used for tie-breaking criteria. Candidates must ensure to appear for Common University Entrance Test for Undergraduate courses to qualify for counselling rounds.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to register for CUET-UG counselling?
faqs.answer: Students who will appear for CUET 2026 exam will be eligible to register for CUET counselling 2026. Students must keep their Class X, Class XII, and CUET scorecards for CUET UG 2026 counselling registration ready. Students must check for below documents: Qualifying examination certificate Transfer certificate Conduct certificate Caste certificate Reservation category certificate Photocopies of original documents

faqs.question: Does NTA announce CUET counselling dates?
faqs.answer: No, National Testing Agency does not announce the CUET dates for counselling. The role of NTA ends soon after the declaration of CUET UG results. To know the CUET counselling sates, candidates must visit the official website of university they desire to take admission in. Every CUET participating university will release its own admission through CUET UG schedule.

faqs.question: What to do after the declaration of CUET result?
faqs.answer: After the declaration of CUET result, the following steps should be taken: Check your result and confirm that you have qualified for the exam. Download your admit card and keep it safe. Start preparing for the counselling process. Apply for the colleges of your choice. Attend the counselling sessions and choose the college that you want to join. Submit the required documents and pay the admission fee. Join the college and start your journey towards higher education.

faqs.question: In which courses can I secure admission through CUET?
faqs.answer: More than 200 CUET participating universities, including central, state, government, private, and deemed institutes offer admission to various undergraduate and integrated courses through Common University Entrance Test (CUET-UG). Each CUET college offers the courses across Science, Humanities, Commerce, Management, Law, Engineering, and other streams. Students planning to get admission through CUET exam have to check the courses offered by their target university on their official website, NTA official website, or at Shiksha page.

faqs.question: How is CUET UG cut off calculated?
faqs.answer: The CUET UG cut off is determined by CUET participating universities seperately. Parameters on the basis of which CUET UG cut off is released are: Total number of candidates that appeared for the CUET UG exam The number of seats offered by the participating universities through CUET UG The difficulty level of the CUET exam Overall performance of the test takers (pass percentage/ score range, etc.) CUET cut off is based on the percentile of the candidate. To calculate the CUET percentile following formula is applied: 100*Number of candidates appeared in the session with a raw score is equal to or less than a candidate/ total number of candidates appeared for CUET UG.

faqs.question: When and where to download CUET cutoff?
faqs.answer: CUET UG 2026 cutoff will be released by the accepting universities. Candidates can check the CUET cutoff on the official website of accepting universities soon after the declaration of results.

faqs.question: What is the difference between city intimation slip and CUET admit card?
faqs.answer: CUET intimation slip and admit card are important documents. CUET admit card has to be carried on the exam day. An intimation slip is released to inform candidates about the allotted city. CUET intimation slip mentions these details: Name of candidates Exam city Date of CUET UG subject exam Shift of the CUET subject opted Medium of the exam The CUET Admit Card is the final document that is released by the NTA a few days before the exam. It contains all the information that is available on the CUET City Intimation Slip, along with the following information: Name and address of the exam centre Roll number Admit card number Photograph of the candidate Candidates will not be allowed to enter the exam hall without the admit card. Read more: CUET Exam

faqs.question: I made a mistake in CUET application form. How can I correct?
faqs.answer: If a candidate has made a mistake in CUET UG 2026 application form, he/she could edit the details in online form once the correction window is open. NTA has noe closed CUET 2026 correction window. During this period, candidates could correct the details in the application, if any. Applicants can edit the below details in the application form: Candidate Name Father Name Mother Name Photograph: Image Upload Signature: Image Upload Class 10/ equivalent details Class 12/ equivalent details Date of Birth Gender Category PwBD

faqs.question: When will CUET DU CSAS portal open?
faqs.answer: DU CSAS portal 2026 will be actiavted at ugadmission.uod.ac.in. University of Delhi launchs CSAS portal 2026 in June. Candidates who will appear for the CUET 2026 exam can register at DU CSAS 2026 portal. Candidates will be required to enter the college and course preference and pay the DU CSAS registration 2026 fee to participate in the admission process. On the basis of the choices entered and CUET 2025 percentile, candidates will be alloted college and course. CUET 2026 result will be declared in first week of July 2026 at cuet.nta.nic.in.

faqs.question: What CUET subjects are required for B.Sc (Hons.) Chemistry?
faqs.answer: To take admission to B.Sc Hons. in Chemistry, candidates must select the below CUET Science subjects while filling the CUET application form 2026: Combination I: Chemistry + Biology/ Biological Studies/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry + Physics OR Combination II: Chemistry + Biology/Biological Studies/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry + Mathematics/Applied Mathematics Merit will be based on the best CUET scores obtained Note: Candidates must verify University and Course requirements. As Subjects may vary from institute to institute

What is CUET?

Common University Entrance Test (CUET) is a national-level entrance examination conducted for admission to Undergraduate programs of central, state, private and deemed universities in India. The examination is conducted by National Testing Agency. It is a single window examination for students desiring to take admission to top universities and courses. CUET UG exam is divided in three sections- Language, Domain Subjects and General Aptitude Test. Candidates can select the limited number of subjects as per the course criteria to appear for exam. CUET exam is essential for admission to all Central Universities and is based in class 12th NCERT curriculum.

There are no prescribed marks for CUET passing criteria. Once candidate has appeared for the exam, candidates must apply for CUET counselling on official website of desired university. Based on counselling applications and CUET score, accepting universities will release the CUET cutoffs. Candidates meeting the cutoff criteria will be shortlisted for admission to desired undergraduate program.

The best college under CUET UG depends on the candidate's course preference. However, top CUET colleges include Delhi University, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and Banaras Hindu University known for their Arts, Science and Commerce courses. Top private CUET colleges include Amity University, LPU and Galgotias whoich CUET scores.

CUET UG exam is conducted in Computer-Based Test Mode. The examination is scheduled in multiple slots depending on the number of registrations for CUET. In this mode of examination, candidates are required to appear for exam online and answer the questions on deskptop with the help of mouse.

Students must keep the required documents ready to fill the application form.

faqs.question: How many questions are there in the language section of CUET UG?
faqs.answer: CUET UG Language section will include 50 questions. Candidates must attempt all questions. There will be no optional questions. The language section will check candidate's reading comprehension based on different types of passages. This section will also include questions from grammar. To prepare for the CUET UG language section, candidates must solve previous year question papers and mock tests to become familiar with the type of questions asked in the exam.

faqs.question: Has NTA announced CUET exam date 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, National Testing Agency has announced the CUET UG 2026 exam date. As per NTA official notification, CUET 2026 exam will be held from May 11 to May 31. CUET registration 2026 commenced on January 03, 2026 at cuet.nta.nic.in. Candidates seeking admission to UG courses through CUET score must stay updated with the CUET exam dates 2026.

faqs.question: How many subjects do I have to take to appear for CUET UG?
faqs.answer: Candidates can select upto five CUET subjects to appear for CUET UG exam. CUET UG subject selection criteria depends upon the course and college candidate desire to take admission in. Candidates must follow the course criteria to select the CUET subjects and align with the subjects studied in class 12th.

faqs.question: Is Mathematics compulsory for CUET UG?
faqs.answer: No, Mathematics is not a compulsory subject to appear for CUET UG exam. NTA conducts CUET UG exam for 13 languages,  23 domain subjects and general test. Candidates can choose any five subjects based on the course and college criteria. CUET Mathematics can be opted if the course criteria suggests.

faqs.question: Is CUET UG exam compulsory?
faqs.answer: Common University Entrance Test is compulsory for admission to the undergraduate programme of central universities. Candidates must have a valid score in CUET UG exam to get admission in desired course and college. Some CUET state and private universities conduct own entrance test and also accept CUET UG scores.

faqs.question: Who can avail the scribe facility for CUET UG?
faqs.answer: PwD candidates who are visually impaired or have disability in the upper limb or have lost hands/fingers which prevents them from operating the CUET UG computer based test will be able to avail the scribe facility. Such candidates can take the help of scribe for reading the questions or keying the answers as per the direction of candidate. The scribe will not be allowed to explain or suggest the answer. To avail the service of scribe, PwD candidates must opt for it while filling the CUET 2026 application form.  The scribe will be provided by CUET 2026 conducting body National Testing Agency (NTA) only.

faqs.question: Is it important to select CUET subjects studied in class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is important for students to align the CUET UG subjects with the subjects studied in class 12th. Top central universities like Delhi University, does not accept CUET subject scores which have not been studied by student in class 12th. While selecting CUET subjects candidates must make sure that CUET subjects must closely or completely align with the subjects studied in class 12th. Failing which, candidate will be disqualified for admission despite a good score.

faqs.question: I have forgotten my CUET application number. How can I login for CUET application form?
faqs.answer: If a candidate has forgotten his/her CUET application number, it can be retrieved by following the steps below: Check registered email ID and phone number for SMS as It includes CUET application form number on successful registration. Check the saved page of CUET application form. or, Candidates may contact at NTA to know their CUET application form number. After getting the CUET application number, students must ensure to note it somewhere for future login process. CUET application form number is required to login and download the admit card or results when released.

faqs.question: How many subjects can a candidate choose in CUET UG while filling the application form?

faqs.question: Which are the non editable details in CUET application form?
faqs.answer: Candidates will not be able to edit the following details in the CUET 2026 application form once submitted: Mobile number Email address Permanent and correspondence address Emergency contact details

faqs.question: What is the total score in CUET UG?
faqs.answer: CUET UG total marks is 250 Marks for each subject. Candidates can choose up to five CUET subjects. Each subject paper has 50 questions which will total to 250 marks for each subject. For every correct answer, candidate will get 5 marks. The CUET total marks will be uniform for all 37 subjects. The Total CUET subjects marks can vary depending on the number of subjects chosen by candidates. If three CUET subjects chosen: 750 total marks If four CUET subjects chosen: 1000 total marks If five CUET subjects chosen: 1250 total marks

faqs.question: When to apply for CUET exam 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates can re-apply for CUET exam 2026. NTA has reopned the CUET application form 2026 online window. Candidates must make sure to have registered for CUET exam and select appropriate CUET subjects to be eligible for admissions. CUET UG application form 2026 re-commenced on February 23 and will be open till February 26.

faqs.question: From where can I download CUET sample papers?
faqs.answer: Common University Entrance Test (CUET) sample papers are released by the conducting body, National Testing Agency (NTA). To download the CUET question papers follow the steps below: Go to- CUET Question Paper Select CUET subject to download the question paper for Click on the tab download Create the login details for new registrations Link to download the CUET question paper will be sent on the registered email ID Click on the link provided and save the PDF.

faqs.question: What is the latest pattern for CUET UG exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates can see the table showing the latest CUET UG exam pattern 2026 below - Section Number of Questions Duration Language 50 60 Minutes Domain Specific 50 General Test 50 Note: The exam pattern is taken from official website of the conducting body and can be changed if instructed by it. Hope this helps your query! All the best!

faqs.question: Will CUET UG exam duration vary for each subject?
faqs.answer: No, CUET UG exam duration will not vary for each subject. The exam duration will be unform for all CUET subjects that is 60 minutes. Candidates will be required to attempt 50 questions within the given time limit. The marking scheme of each question remains the same.

faqs.question: What type of questions are asked in the CUET exam?
faqs.answer: The CUET questions are objective in nature and carries four options also known as MCQs. Candidates will have to choose the correct answer option and click on it with the help of mouse. Since CUET UG 2026 exam will be conducted in a CBT mode, test-takers will be able to mark only one answer option. In case it is the correct option, students will get +5 marks and in case of wrong answer, negative marking scheme will be applied. Hence, candidates must ensure the accuracy of the answer before selecting the answer.

faqs.question: How many subjects can I choose for the CUET exam?
faqs.answer: From CUET UG 2026 onwards, candidates can now choose for five CUET subjects. Earlier, the subject choices were six. With the rediuction in number of CUET subjects, the choices have been reduced. Candidates can opt for five subjects from 23 domain subjects of any stream irrespective of subjects studied in class 12th.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of the CUET exam?
faqs.answer: The difficulty level of the CUET exam varies between moderate and tough. Since the CUET UG exam is held for multiple subjects and slots, the difficulty level of the exam varies from subject to subject. Sometimes, the difficulty level may also vary for different slots. While for the well-prepared candidates, the difficulty level will be low, for the underprepared students, the level of difficulty will be on the higher side.

faqs.question: Which are the languages included in CUET UG?
faqs.answer: CUET UG langauge section will now consist of 13 languages instead of 33 languages. The 13 langauges of CUET UG 2026 are: English, Hindi, Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu. Whereas, the languages which have been deleted are: Arabic, Bodo, Chinese, Dogri, French, German, Italian, Janpanese, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili, Manipuri, Nepali, Persian, Russian, Santhali, Sindhi, Spanish, Tibetan, Sanskrit.

faqs.question: What is CUET exam duration for each subject?
faqs.answer: CUET UG exam pattern have three sections. Section I- 13 Languages Section II- 23 Domain Subject Section III- General Test Candidates will get 60 minutes for each language, domain subject and language. Candidates will not be given extra time

faqs.question: What special facilities are provided to PwD candidates to appear for CUET exam?
faqs.answer: As per the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment guidelines, PwD candidates will be provided with following facilities: Scribe facility : In case the candidate has physical limitation and required a scribe for writing the exam, he/she must be certified in the format provided by CMO/Civil Surgeon/ Medical Superintendent of a Government Health Care Institution. Extra time : PwD candidates will get extra time of one hour whether such candidates use scribe facilities or not.

faqs.question: Does NTA releases the CUET mock test?
faqs.answer: National Testing Agency is expected to release CUET UG mock test at nta.ac.in. If released, candidates can appear for CUET mock test by following steps below: Visit official link og NT nta.ac.in Click on tab 'Mock Test' Now select exam name Select paper name Click on 'Start Mock Test'

faqs.question: Is it compulsory to attempt all the sections of the CUET question paper?
faqs.answer: CUET UG question paper for each subject will consist of 50 questions. Candidates will be required to attempt all questions and no optional questions will be provided. In CUET UG 2026 there are 37 subjects- 13 languages, 23 domain subjects and general tests. While filling the CUET application form, candidates can select upto five CUET subjects aligning with the subjects studied in class 12th and course requirement. Candidates must attempt all the questions of the subjects selected. However, candidates must keep in mind the negative marking and select the options carefully.

faqs.question: Which are the central universities accepting CUET UG scores?

faqs.question: Which IIT accepts CUET score?
faqs.answer: CUET UG scores are not accepted by IITs. Common University Entrance Test for UG is conducted for admission to state, central, private, deemed and government institutions. Admission to UG courses of IITs is offered through other national level entrance examinations.

faqs.question: How many universities accept CUET score?
faqs.answer: Common University Entrance Test (CUET) score 2026 will be accepted by more than 205 universities (central, state, private and deemed) across India. On the basis of the CUET UG score, candidates are offered admission to UG programme of the participating colleges. Candidates applying for admission to UG programme must ensure to check the course eligibility criteria before filling the application form. Some of the top CUET accepting universities with NIRF ranking 2024 are: Name State NIRF Rank 2024 Jawaharlal Nehru University Delhi 2 Jamia Millia Islamia Delhi 3 Banaras Hindu University Uttar Pradesh 5 University of Delhi Delhi 6 Aligarh Muslim University Uttar Pradesh 8

faqs.question: Is CUET UG college list released?
faqs.answer: NTA has released the CUET UG 2026 college and universities list. Candidates preparing for CUET UG 2026 can check the list of CUET accepting colleges 2026 at cuet.nta.nic.in. More than 250 universities are accepting CUET scores for admission to 2026-27 academic year. Candidates can now check the university-wise UG courses and eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Which are top central universities accepting CUET score?
faqs.answer: The top central universities accepting CUET UG scores are: NIRF 2- Jawaharlal Nehru University NIRF 4- Jamia Millia Islamia NIRF 6- Banaras Hindu University NIRF 5- University of Delhi NIRF 10- Aligarh Muslim University

faqs.question: What is CUET result date?
faqs.answer: NTA will announce the CUET result 2026 tentatively in first week of July. CUET UG result 2026 will be announced at cuet.nta.nic.in online. Candidates who will appear for the exam can check their scores online. Students will be required to enter their login credentials to view the CUET scorecard 2026. NTA will mention the applicant's details and subject-wise score for CUET 2026. The scores will be sent to the universities for which candidates have applied soon after the declaration of results. Candidates must note that the role of NTA ends soon after the declaration of CUET results 2026.

faqs.question: Is 700 a good score in CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, 700 is a good score in CUET. This score can help candidates place in top colleges of Delhi University, banaras Hindu University and Allahabad University. 700 score is considered to a CUET good score creating a percentile of 95+.

faqs.question: What is CUET UG cut off for top courses?
faqs.answer: CUET UG cut off will vary from course to course and universities. To know the cut off for CUET UG courses, candidates must stay updated with the notification released by the universities for admissions. As per the previous year analysis, candidates can expect the CUET UG cut off for various top courses under Arts, Commerce and Science as mentioned below: University CUET cutoff link Delhi University CUET DU Cutoff Allahabad University CUET AU cutoff Banaras Hindu University CUET BHU cutoff

faqs.question: How to mark using CUET answer key?
faqs.answer: After downloading the CUET provisional answer key, candidates must also download CUET response sheet. Candidates must match answers marked on the response sheet. While marking correct answers, candidates must follow marking scheme mentioned below: +5 marks will be given for every correct answer 1 mark will be deducted for every incorrect answer

faqs.question: What if the question is dropped and answer key is revised in CUET UG?
faqs.answer: If the question is dropped or the answer key is revised, NTA will give score as If multiple options are correct then students who marked any correct option will get five marks. If all options provided are correct then all students who gave answer will be given five marks. If none of the options is correct, a question is wrong, or a question is removed then all students who attempted the removed question will get five marks.

faqs.question: When will the CUET final answer key be released?
faqs.answer: National Testing Agency will release the CUET 2026 final answer key before the announcement of results. NTA releases the revised CUET answer key based on the objections received at cuet.nta.nic.in. Candidates are given opportunity to challenge the CUET UG answer key 2026 within a three-day window. The date to challenge the answer key will be notified. Only paid challenges made during the stipulated period will be considered. CUET answer key challenges without justification/evidence, and those filed on any other medium other than the prescribed link for CUET UG will not be considered. CUET UG 2026 results will be compiled based on the final answer key. Candidates will not get the outcome of the challenges received.

faqs.question: When will CUET result be declared?
faqs.answer: CUET result 2026 will be declared tentatively in first week of July 2026. Candidates who will appear for the exam can download their CUET scorecard online when released. The link to download the CUET scorecard will be available at CUET results 2026 . Candidates will be required to enter the login credentials to view the CUET 2026 scorecard online. CUET scores are used for admission to various universities/colleges that candidates has applied for while filling the application form. Candidates must download and take the print of the CUET 2026 results when released. CUET UG 2026 exam will be held from May 11 to May 31.

faqs.question: Are candidates required to apply separately for all the universities of CUET UG for counselling?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates seeking admission through CUET UG are required to apply separately to each university's counseling process through university portal. National Testing Agency conducts CUET examination but does not conduct counseling or admission process. Each CUET UG participating university conducts its own counseling rounds based on CUET scores and their specific admission criteria.

faqs.question: I am class 12th board topper. Do I need to participate in CUET UG counselling? Or will I be offered direct admission in central university?
faqs.answer: Yes, you will have to appear for the CUET counselling rounds of the central universities. Admission to central universities is offered based on CUET UG scores. Candidates must note that class 12th marks will not be considered for final admission to UG courses of central universities. Class 12th marks are used for tie-breaking criteria. Candidates must ensure to appear for Common University Entrance Test for Undergraduate courses to qualify for counselling rounds.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to register for CUET-UG counselling?
faqs.answer: Students who will appear for CUET 2026 exam will be eligible to register for CUET counselling 2026. Students must keep their Class X, Class XII, and CUET scorecards for CUET UG 2026 counselling registration ready. Students must check for below documents: Qualifying examination certificate Transfer certificate Conduct certificate Caste certificate Reservation category certificate Photocopies of original documents

faqs.question: Does NTA announce CUET counselling dates?
faqs.answer: No, National Testing Agency does not announce the CUET dates for counselling. The role of NTA ends soon after the declaration of CUET UG results. To know the CUET counselling sates, candidates must visit the official website of university they desire to take admission in. Every CUET participating university will release its own admission through CUET UG schedule.

faqs.question: What to do after the declaration of CUET result?
faqs.answer: After the declaration of CUET result, the following steps should be taken: Check your result and confirm that you have qualified for the exam. Download your admit card and keep it safe. Start preparing for the counselling process. Apply for the colleges of your choice. Attend the counselling sessions and choose the college that you want to join. Submit the required documents and pay the admission fee. Join the college and start your journey towards higher education.

faqs.question: In which courses can I secure admission through CUET?
faqs.answer: More than 200 CUET participating universities, including central, state, government, private, and deemed institutes offer admission to various undergraduate and integrated courses through Common University Entrance Test (CUET-UG). Each CUET college offers the courses across Science, Humanities, Commerce, Management, Law, Engineering, and other streams. Students planning to get admission through CUET exam have to check the courses offered by their target university on their official website, NTA official website, or at Shiksha page.

faqs.question: How is CUET UG cut off calculated?
faqs.answer: The CUET UG cut off is determined by CUET participating universities seperately. Parameters on the basis of which CUET UG cut off is released are: Total number of candidates that appeared for the CUET UG exam The number of seats offered by the participating universities through CUET UG The difficulty level of the CUET exam Overall performance of the test takers (pass percentage/ score range, etc.) CUET cut off is based on the percentile of the candidate. To calculate the CUET percentile following formula is applied: 100*Number of candidates appeared in the session with a raw score is equal to or less than a candidate/ total number of candidates appeared for CUET UG.

faqs.question: When and where to download CUET cutoff?
faqs.answer: CUET UG 2026 cutoff will be released by the accepting universities. Candidates can check the CUET cutoff on the official website of accepting universities soon after the declaration of results.

faqs.question: What is the difference between city intimation slip and CUET admit card?
faqs.answer: CUET intimation slip and admit card are important documents. CUET admit card has to be carried on the exam day. An intimation slip is released to inform candidates about the allotted city. CUET intimation slip mentions these details: Name of candidates Exam city Date of CUET UG subject exam Shift of the CUET subject opted Medium of the exam The CUET Admit Card is the final document that is released by the NTA a few days before the exam. It contains all the information that is available on the CUET City Intimation Slip, along with the following information: Name and address of the exam centre Roll number Admit card number Photograph of the candidate Candidates will not be allowed to enter the exam hall without the admit card. Read more: CUET Exam

faqs.question: I made a mistake in CUET application form. How can I correct?
faqs.answer: If a candidate has made a mistake in CUET UG 2026 application form, he/she could edit the details in online form once the correction window is open. NTA has noe closed CUET 2026 correction window. During this period, candidates could correct the details in the application, if any. Applicants can edit the below details in the application form: Candidate Name Father Name Mother Name Photograph: Image Upload Signature: Image Upload Class 10/ equivalent details Class 12/ equivalent details Date of Birth Gender Category PwBD

faqs.question: When will CUET DU CSAS portal open?
faqs.answer: DU CSAS portal 2026 will be actiavted at ugadmission.uod.ac.in. University of Delhi launchs CSAS portal 2026 in June. Candidates who will appear for the CUET 2026 exam can register at DU CSAS 2026 portal. Candidates will be required to enter the college and course preference and pay the DU CSAS registration 2026 fee to participate in the admission process. On the basis of the choices entered and CUET 2025 percentile, candidates will be alloted college and course. CUET 2026 result will be declared in first week of July 2026 at cuet.nta.nic.in.

faqs.question: What CUET subjects are required for B.Sc (Hons.) Chemistry?
faqs.answer: To take admission to B.Sc Hons. in Chemistry, candidates must select the below CUET Science subjects while filling the CUET application form 2026: Combination I: Chemistry + Biology/ Biological Studies/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry + Physics OR Combination II: Chemistry + Biology/Biological Studies/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry + Mathematics/Applied Mathematics Merit will be based on the best CUET scores obtained Note: Candidates must verify University and Course requirements. blocks.value: UPCET exam has been scrapped and has been replaced by other national-level exams such as CUET, JEE Main and NATA for admission into colleges affiliated with AKTU, MMMUT, and other state universities of Uttar Pradesh.
Postgraduation courses such as MBA , MCA , MTech , MURP, MPharm, MDes and MArch will be offered through the CUET PG exam. Integrated MBA and Intergrated MCA courses will be offered through CUET exam.
What is UPCET 2022?

Known earlier as UPSEE, Uttar Pradesh Combined Entrance Test (UPCET) is a gateway for candidates seeking admission to various professional courses offered at the undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) levels at all affiliated institutes of Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology (MMMUT), Gorakhpur and Harcourt Butler Technical University (HBTU), Kanpur. The exam will be conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA) in the computer-based test mode across various cities.

General UPCET 2022/UPSEE Eligibility Criteria

value: Candidates should have passed the qualifying exam from any institution in UP or the parents should have the domicile of Uttar Pradesh.
If the candidates have not passed the qualifying exam from an institution in UP, then they will be required to produce their parent's domicile certificate.
Candidates who do meet the domicile requirements will also be eligible to appear for the exam if they meet the other required criteria.
Candidates in the final year of the qualifying exam or are awaiting results are also eligible to appear for UPCET.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for MCA (Integrated)

value: Candidates should have qualified intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Mathematics/Statistics/Accountancy as compulsory subjects and one of the optional subjects - Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subjects.
Should have obtained at least 45 percent aggregate (40 percent aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) in the above subjects taken together.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for BPharm

value: Should have passed (with/without grace) intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects along with Mathematics/Biology subject.

Should have scored a minimum 50 per cent aggregate (45 per cent for SC/ST).

Candidates who have passed (with/without grace) three years B.Sc. degree and passed Class 12 with mathematics as one of the subjects from any recognised University; securing minimum 45 per cent aggregate (40 per cent for SC/ST) in aggregate. These candidates shall be considered only after filling the supernumerary seats in this category with the candidates belonging to the Diploma stream.
Admission to the second year of B.Tech (Lateral entry) of HBTU would be governed by the eligibility criteria laid down by HBTU.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Admission Process
Check out the important UPCET 2022 admission process:
UPCET 2022 Admission Process
Step 1: UPCET 2022 application form

Candidates can register online on the official website and fill the UPCET 2022 application form . The application fee is INR 1,300 which is to be paid online through debit/credit card or net banking. While filling up the UPCET application form, candidates can select up to five institutes/colleges to send their scores for admission. UPCET 2022 exam will be held in the computer-based test mode across various cities in India.
Step 2: UPCET 2022 admit card

UPCET 2022 admit cards will be released for the registered candidates a few days before the exam. Candidates must download their UPCET 2022 admit card and take a printout of the same before the exam, as it is a mandatory document. Admit cards can be downloaded till the exam day. To check the UPCET 2022 admit card, the candidates will have to log in using the required credentials. While visiting the exam centre, the candidates will have to present the UPCET admit card along with identity proof.
Step 3: UPCET 2022 exam

UPCET 2022 will be conducted in the computer-based test mode. The test will be conducted in more than 40 test centres across the country. Candidates will have to visit the exam centre to take the exam.
Step 4: UPCET 2022 result

NTA will announce the UPCET 2022 results online. The test takers can check UPCET 2022 result and download the scorecard by entering their login credentials. The scorecards will not be sent to any candidate by post. Candidates can check the result only in online mode. On the basis of the result, UPCET 2022 merit list will be prepared by the authorities. Candidates will be invited for the counselling session based on the merit list.
UPCET 2022 Exam Pattern

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria

value: Candidates should have passed the qualifying exam from any institution in UP or the parents should have the domicile of Uttar Pradesh.

value: Should have passed (with/without grace) intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects along with Mathematics/Biology subject.

value: Candidates must have passed (with/without grace) the intermediate examination of the U.P. Board or the Class 12 level examination or its equivalent.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria
General UPCET 2022/UPSEE Eligibility Criteria

value: Candidates should have passed the qualifying exam from any institution in UP or the parents should have the domicile of Uttar Pradesh.

value: Should have passed (with/without grace) intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects along with Mathematics/Biology subject.

value: Candidates must have passed (with/without grace) the intermediate examination of the U.P. Board or the Class 12 level examination or its equivalent.

author.name: CMS Admin
author.role: By CMS Admin

blocks.value: UPMCAT has now been scrapped and student are enrolled on the basis of the scores obtained in UPSEE .

Candidates must ensure that they check the eligibility criteria of the exam before applying. Applications that do not meet the eligibility criteria of the exam will be rejected by the officials. The On-Line application form submission consists of following three simple steps.
(i) Registration (Filling up of Personal and other Details)
(ii) Uploading of Scanned Images of Photograph, Signature and Thumb Impression
(iii) Payment of Examination Fee and Printing of the “Confirmation Page”
To fill the application form, follow the below mentioned steps:

value: Visit the official website and click on the link for PG entrance exams
On clicking the ‘Apply’ link at the bottom of the page, the candidate will be redirected to a new screen where the details need to be filled
Here, the candidate needs to register himself/herself by entering personal details
Choose a password and a security question
Submit the application form by clicking on the submit button
The candidate will get the option of reviewing the application form
Once you are sure that all the details have been mentioned correctly, click on ‘Final Submit’
The candidate will receive an application number generated by the system
Here the candidate may choose to logout and fill the application form later, or might continue with the process
Next, the candidate needs to upload an a recent color passport size, a clear scanned image of the signature, and a clear scanned image of his/her left thumb impression and save
The next step is to pay the fee which can be done only through Credit Card / Debit Card / Net Banking. Take a note of the transaction number
Please do not send the hard copy / soft copy / print-out of the Confirmation page or any other document to the University at this stage

blocks.value: Documents required

value: A personal mobile phone number and/or a personal E-Mail id
A recent color passport size photograph (3.5cm X 4.5cm) in JPEG Format with a maximum size of 100 KB
A clear scanned image of the signature (3.5cm X 1.5cm) in JPEG format with a maximum size of 30KB
A clear scanned image of the candidate’s left thumb impression (3.5cm X 1.5cm) in JPEG format with a maximum size of 30KB

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria
General UPCET 2022/UPSEE Eligibility Criteria

value: Candidates should have passed the qualifying exam from any institution in UP or the parents should have the domicile of Uttar Pradesh.
If the candidates have not passed the qualifying exam from an institution in UP, then they will be required to produce their parent's domicile certificate.
Candidates who do meet the domicile requirements will also be eligible to appear for the exam if they meet the other required criteria.
Candidates in the final year of the qualifying exam or are awaiting results are also eligible to appear for UPCET.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for MCA (Integrated)

value: Candidates should have qualified intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Mathematics/Statistics/Accountancy as compulsory subjects and one of the optional subjects - Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subjects.
Should have obtained at least 45 percent aggregate (40 percent aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) in the above subjects taken together.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for BPharm

value: Should have passed (with/without grace) intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects along with Mathematics/Biology subject.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for BHMCT/BFAD /BFA/B Voc/ BDes/MBA (Integrated)

value: Candidates must have passed (with/without grace) the intermediate examination of the U.P. Board or the Class 12 level examination or its equivalent.
Should have secured a minimum of 45 per cent aggregate (40 per cent aggregate for SC/ST category candidates).

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for MCA in any institution affiliated to AKTU, Lucknow

value: Candidates should have passed BCA/ Bachelor degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent Degree or passed BSc. /BCom/ BA with Mathematics at Class 12 level or at graduation level.
Should have scored a minimum 50 per cent aggregate (45 per cent for SC/ST).

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for BTech Lateral Entry

value: Candidates who have passed (with/without grace) three years Engineering Diploma from an Institution located in UP with minimum 45 percent aggregate (40 percent for SC/ST) OR whose parents (Father or mother) are domicile of Uttar Pradesh and he/she has passed three years Engineering Diploma with minimum 45 percent aggregate (40 percent for SC/ST) recognised by the Board of Technical Education, U.P., in any branch of Engineering (except Agriculture Engg., Pharmacy and Architecture).

Candidates who have passed (with/without grace) three years B.Sc. degree and passed Class 12 with mathematics as one of the subjects from any recognised University; securing minimum 45 per cent aggregate (40 per cent for SC/ST) in aggregate. These candidates shall be considered only after filling the supernumerary seats in this category with the candidates belonging to the Diploma stream.
Admission to the second year of B.Tech (Lateral entry) of HBTU would be governed by the eligibility criteria laid down by HBTU.

Candidates can check here complete details about the admission process of Sandip University.

After all admission formalities are complete, class commencement schedule will be published on notice board and/or university website.

Sandip University Scholarships Scheme for Maharashtra State S.No Scholarship Type Criteria Value of Scholarship 1 Merit Scholarship - I 90% and above in the qualifying examination* 100% Tuition Fee waive off 2 Merit Scholarship - II 85% to 89.99% in the qualifying examination* 75% Tuition Fee waive off 3 Merit Scholarship - III 75% to 84.99%in the qualifying examination* 50% Tuition Fee waive off b. Sandip University Scholarship Scheme for Outside Maharashtra State (OMS) - Applicable for current year and continuation subject to performance S.No Scholarship Type Criteria Value of Scholarship 1 Merit Scholarship - I 85% and above in the qualifying examination* 100% Tuition Fee waive off 2 Merit Scholarship - II 80% to 84.99% I in the qualifying examination* 75% Tuition Fee waive off 3 Merit Scholarship - III 75% to 79.99% in the qualifying examination* 50% Tuition Fee waive off

faqs.question: Are the SU JEE scholarships scheme only for Engineering courses?
faqs.answer: Scholarships apply students of all UG courses and MBA programmes. The Merit Scholarship will be awarded to a maximum 15% of the students who take admission for the course. Students selected in the first year for scholarship will continue to get a scholarship in subsequent years as per respective slabs and academic score of that particular academic year.

faqs.question: Is the SU JEE scholarship only for the first year?
faqs.answer: Students selected in the first year for scholarship will continue to get scholarship in subsequent years as per respective slabs and academic score of that particular academic year. Therefore, the candidates must try to score well in SU JEE entrance test.
